entries.reviewSummary: Defines multiple employer self-insured health plans, leasing company arrangements, and criteria for fully insured plans.

headings.title: Definition of multiple employer self-insured health plan
headings.reviewNote: Defines multiple employer self-insured health plans offered by employee leasing companies or multiple employers.

headings.title: Criteria for fully insured plan status
headings.reviewNote: Provides that plan is fully insured only if a licensed insurer retains ultimate responsibility for all contract benefits.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates certificates of authority for multiple employer self-insured plans, unauthorized insurer penalties, and statutory exemptions.

headings.title: Certificate of authority requirement for self-insured plans
headings.reviewNote: Declares it unlawful for multiple employer self-insured health plans to transact business without director certificate.

headings.title: Penalties applicable to unauthorized self-insured plans
headings.reviewNote: Subjects multiple employer plans transacting business without certificate to unauthorized insurer penalties under section 375.786.

headings.title: Exemptions for municipal and ERISA plans
headings.reviewNote: Exempts political subdivision risk pools, ERISA-preempted plans, and entities outside department jurisdiction.

headings.title: Exemption for pre-1993 tax-exempt trade associations
headings.reviewNote: Exempts pre-1993 501(c)(6) homogenous association plans upon providing IRS tax-exempt determination certificate.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes application rules, employee thresholds, annual license fees, and mandatory guaranty association disclaimer notices.

headings.title: Certificate application and minimum covered employee threshold
headings.reviewNote: Requires application on director forms and establishes minimum two-hundred-fifty covered employee quarterly threshold.

headings.title: Annual license fee on Missouri claims
headings.reviewNote: Imposes annual March license fee equal to two percent of Missouri claims paid, credited to insurance dedicated fund.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage evidence and guaranty disclaimer notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires coverage document delivery within forty-five days with conspicuous boldfaced guaranty association disclaimer.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires multiple employer self-insured health plans to establish loss reserves and maintain statutory surplus accounts.

headings.title: Loss reserves for incurred losses required
headings.reviewNote: Requires plans to establish loss reserves for reported and unreported incurred losses and unearned premiums.

headings.title: Surplus account minimum balance requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires surplus account equal to greater of six hundred thousand dollars or twice authorized control level risk-based capital.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs voluntary dissolution of multiple employer self-insured health plans, director approval conditions, and pro rata asset distributions.

headings.title: Application for plan dissolution and approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires plans to apply to the director to dissolve, with approval or disapproval within sixty days, and requires approval if no outstanding liabilities exist or a licensed insurer irrevocably commits to pay them.

headings.title: Proportional distribution of plan assets upon dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Distributes remaining assets to participating employers proportional to contributions made during preceding five years.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes director enforcement against unsound self-insured plans, license revocations, civil fines, and delinquency proceedings.

headings.title: Director remedies for unsound plan condition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes license suspension, revocation, or civil action with fines up to fifty thousand dollars for hazardous conditions.

headings.title: Delinquency proceedings against domestic self-insured plans
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to commence delinquency proceedings to supervise, rehabilitate, or liquidate domestic plans.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires participating employers to execute personal liability agreements for unpaid claims, state filing, and non-execution liability.

headings.title: Employer personal liability agreement for unpaid claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires participating employers to execute agreement agreeing personally to pay unpaid covered employee claims.

headings.title: Filing employer agreements with insurance director
headings.reviewNote: Mandates filing copies of executed employer agreements with license application and within ten days of new joiners.

headings.title: Employer deemed liability despite missing agreement
headings.reviewNote: Provides that failure to execute agreement does not excuse employer liability and deems joining employer to have agreed.

entries.reviewSummary: Restricts public advertising of multiple employer plans, exempts certificated plans, and authorizes licensed brokers.

headings.title: Public marketing prohibition and certificate exemption
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits advertising plans to public while exempting plans holding certificate of authority approved by director.

headings.title: Authorized use of licensed insurance brokers
headings.reviewNote: Requires carrier administrators to permit willing appointed brokers in good standing to quote, sell, or market plans.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates third-party access to provider network contracts, required contract notices, website registries, and statutory exemptions.

headings.title: Definitions for provider network contract access
headings.reviewNote: Defines contracting entity, health care services, participating provider, provider network contract, and third party.

headings.title: Conditions for granting third party network access
headings.reviewNote: Establishes conditions including provider consent and contract disclosures before granting third parties network discounts.

headings.title: Provider not bound by unauthorized contract access
headings.reviewNote: Relieves health care providers from performing services under network contracts granted in violation of statutory rules.

headings.title: Website or toll-free number identifying third parties
headings.reviewNote: Requires a contracting entity granting third-party access to maintain an internet website or toll-free telephone number identifying the third party to be used to reimburse the participating provider.

headings.title: Identifying discount source on explanation of benefits
headings.reviewNote: Requires a contracting entity granting third-party access to ensure explanations of benefits or remittance advice identify the contractual source of any applicable discount.

headings.title: Exemptions for affiliates and state-sponsored programs
headings.reviewNote: Exempts access granted to brand licensee program entities or affiliates (with affiliate list on website) and provider network contracts for state-sponsored programs including MO HealthNet and the children's health insurance program.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines terms, requires contracting entities to update electronic provider and next paper materials upon official notification, and requires market conduct examination consideration of violations.

headings.title: Definitions for provider directory updates
headings.reviewNote: Defines contracting entity, department, official notification, participating provider, and provider for dental network directory update requirements.

headings.title: Directory updates upon official provider notification
headings.reviewNote: Requires a contracting entity, upon official notification, to make the changes in its electronic provider material and next edition of paper material.

headings.title: Market conduct examination consideration of violations
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department, when determining market conduct examination results under sections 374.202 to 374.207, to consider violations of this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates written agreements between third-party administrators and insurers, specifying duties, underwriting rules, and termination.

headings.title: Written agreement required for third party administrators
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits an administrator from acting without a written agreement with the insurer, retained by both for the agreement's duration and five years thereafter.

headings.title: Statement of duties and underwriting standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires agreement to state expected duties, underwriting standards, and written insurer rules for administration.

headings.title: Agreement termination and suspension during dispute
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes written termination for cause and allows insurer to suspend administrator authority during pending disputes.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs administrator book and record maintenance, five-year retention, department examination access, and insurer ownership.

headings.title: Maintenance and five-year retention of administrator records
headings.reviewNote: Requires administrator to maintain transaction records according to insurance standards for five years after creation.

headings.title: Director access and trade secret protections
headings.reviewNote: Grants director examination access while protecting trade secret identities unless needed in regulatory proceedings.

headings.title: Insurer ownership of records and administrator access
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that insurer owns administrator records while granting administrator continuing access to fulfill obligations.

headings.title: Record transfer to successor administrator upon cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes transferring records to successor administrator upon agreement cancellation with written notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Places responsibility for benefits, premium rates, underwriting, claims procedures, and reinsurance on insurers using administrators, and requires semiannual reviews including at least one on-site audit.

headings.title: Insurer responsibility for benefits and underwriting criteria
headings.reviewNote: Makes insurer responsible for determining benefits, premium rates, underwriting criteria, claims rules, and reinsurance.

headings.title: Sole insurer responsibility for competent administration
headings.reviewNote: Declares that providing competent administration of insurance programs is the sole responsibility of the insurer.

headings.title: Semiannual reviews including on-site audit
headings.reviewNote: Requires an insurer, where an administrator administers benefits for more than one hundred certificate holders, to review the administrator's operations at least semiannually, with at least one review an on-site audit.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires administrators to hold premiums in fiduciary capacity, maintain accounts, restrict withdrawals, and pay claims on insurer drafts.

headings.title: Fiduciary capacity for collected insurance premiums
headings.reviewNote: Requires premiums collected by administrators to be held in fiduciary capacity and promptly remitted or deposited.

headings.title: Accounting records for multi-insurer fiduciary accounts
headings.reviewNote: Mandates detailed deposit and withdrawal records for each insurer when funds are deposited in shared fiduciary accounts.

headings.title: Withdrawals from premium fiduciary accounts restricted
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits paying claims from premium fiduciary accounts and regulates authorized agreement withdrawals.

headings.title: Claims payments on authorized insurer drafts
headings.reviewNote: Requires all claims paid from insurer funds to be drawn only on drafts or checks authorized by the insurer.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits administrator compensation contingent on claims savings while permitting compensation based on premiums or claim volume.

headings.title: Prohibition on commissions contingent on claims savings
headings.reviewNote: Bars administrator commissions, fees, or charges contingent upon savings in loss adjustment, settlement, and payment, while permitting performance-based compensation for hospital or other auditing services.

headings.title: Compensation based on premiums or claim counts
headings.reviewNote: Permits administrator compensation based on collected premiums or volume of processed claims.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires written notice to insureds regarding administrator identity, separate identification of non-premium charges, and fee disclosures.

headings.title: Written notice of administrator relationship required
headings.reviewNote: Requires administrator to provide written notice approved by insurer advising covered individuals of relationship and identities.

headings.title: Separate identification of non-premium charges
headings.reviewNote: Requires identifying reasons for collected charges separately from premiums and prohibits charging for services paid by insurer.

headings.title: Disclosure of administrative compensation to insurer
headings.reviewNote: Directs administrator to disclose all fees, commissions, and charges received from all sources in connection with administration.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs administrator certificates of authority, application contents and one-thousand-dollar fee, refusal grounds, annual renewal at two hundred fifty dollars, notice of material changes, and surety bond.

headings.title: Certificate of authority required for administrators
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits acting or holding oneself out as an administrator in Missouri without a valid certificate of authority.

headings.title: Application contents and required fee
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes application details, organizational documents, officer qualifications, financial statements, business plans, and fee.

headings.title: Inspection of administrator contracts with insurers
headings.reviewNote: Requires applicant to make available for director inspection all contracts with insurers and persons using administrative services.

headings.title: Grounds for refusal to issue certificate
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to refuse a certificate if the administrator or responsible individual is not competent, trustworthy, financially responsible, or of good reputation, has had a license denied or revoked, or has been subject to disciplinary action (source note: word 'result' appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Annual renewal, fee, and penalty for lacking certificate
headings.reviewNote: Makes the certificate renewable annually on July first on application and a two-hundred-fifty-dollar fee if no revocation grounds exist and required bond is in force, and subjects failure to hold one to an administrative penalty of up to fifty thousand dollars.

headings.title: Immediate notice of material change to director
headings.reviewNote: Requires an administrator to immediately notify the director of any material change in ownership, control, or other circumstance affecting its qualification for a certificate of authority.

headings.title: Surety bond filing requirement and affiliate exception
headings.reviewNote: Requires each administrator to file a surety bond in the amount and form the director prescribes from a licensed or approved insurer, except affiliates or subsidiaries of licensed insurers if the director is satisfied with the insurer's financial condition.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates annual reports filed by administrators by March first, client disclosures, fully insured and stop-loss carrier identities, and fee.

headings.title: Annual report filing deadline and verification
headings.reviewNote: Requires administrators to file verified annual report for preceding year with director on or before March first.

headings.title: Disclosure of client insurers and trusts
headings.reviewNote: Requires report to include complete names and addresses of all insurers and trusts with which administrator had agreements.

headings.title: Identification of fully insured, self-insured, or stop-loss plans
headings.reviewNote: Requires the annual report to identify which insurers or trusts are fully insured by a licensed insurer, self-insured, or have stop-loss coverage.

headings.title: Identification of stop-loss and primary carriers
headings.reviewNote: Requires the annual report to identify the carrier and policy or certificate number for fully insured insurers or trusts or those with stop-loss coverage.

headings.title: Annual report filing fee requirement
headings.reviewNote: Imposes two-hundred-fifty-dollar filing fee payable at the time of filing annual administrator report.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs mandatory and discretionary suspension or revocation of administrator certificates, immediate emergency suspensions, and cease orders.

headings.title: Mandatory grounds for suspension or revocation
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to suspend or revoke if the administrator is in unsound financial condition, uses hazardous or injurious methods, or has failed to satisfy a final judgment in this state within sixty days.

headings.title: Discretionary grounds for suspension or revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes discretionary suspension or revocation for rule or insurance law violations, refusing examination, unjust claim refusals, affiliation with unauthorized entities, felony convictions, disqualifying qualifications, or suspension in another state.

headings.title: Immediate suspension without notice or hearing
headings.reviewNote: Allows the director to immediately suspend a certificate without advance notice or hearing if the administrator is insolvent or impaired, subject to a delinquency proceeding in any state, or poses an imminent threat to public health, safety, or welfare.

headings.title: Administrative orders under section 374.046
headings.reviewNote: Allows the director to issue administrative orders under section 374.046 for violations or material aiding of violations, and makes a violation a level three violation under section 374.049.

headings.title: Director civil action for relief under section 374.048
headings.reviewNote: Allows the director to maintain a civil action for relief authorized under section 374.048 for violations or material aiding of violations, and makes a violation a level three violation under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes title for Long-term Care Insurance Act and defines terms including applicant, certificate, group policy, and tax-qualified contracts.

headings.title: Title of Long-term Care Insurance Act
headings.reviewNote: Designates sections 376.1100 to 376.1130 as the Long-term Care Insurance Act.

headings.title: Definitions for long-term care insurance
headings.reviewNote: Defines applicant, certificate, group long-term care insurance, policy, and qualified long-term care contracts.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes applicability of long-term care act to post-2002 policies, legislative purposes, Medicare supplement exclusion, and compliance.

headings.title: Applicability date and Medicare supplement exclusion
headings.reviewNote: Applies long-term care act to policies issued on or after August 28, 2002, excluding Medicare supplement regulations.

headings.title: Legislative purposes of long-term care act
headings.reviewNote: States purposes to promote policy availability, protect applicants, establish standards, and facilitate policy comparison.

headings.title: Mandatory statutory compliance for long-term care
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that any policy or rider advertised, marketed, or offered as long-term care comply with statutory provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes director regulations and sets long-term care policy standards, including cancellation bars, preexisting condition limits, eligibility conditioning limits, free-look and cancellation refunds, and actuarially justified rate increases.

headings.title: Regulatory disclosure and policy content standards
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director regulations establishing full disclosure standards, renewability terms, and benefit definitions.

headings.title: Prohibited cancellation and skilled care restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits policy cancellation based on age or health deterioration, replacement waiting periods, and skilled-only coverage.

headings.title: Preexisting condition definition and exclusion period limits
headings.reviewNote: Bars non-group policies from using a more restrictive preexisting condition definition (six months before coverage) and permits excluding such losses unless they begin within six months after coverage takes effect.

headings.title: Director extension of preexisting condition periods
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to extend the preexisting condition limitation periods for specific age groups in specific policy forms upon findings that extension is in the public's best interest.

headings.title: Underwriting applications and health questions permitted
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that preexisting condition limits do not prohibit insurers from using health underwriting applications.

headings.title: Prohibition on institutionalization prior eligibility conditions
headings.reviewNote: Bars policies conditioning any benefits on prior hospitalization, institutional care benefits on a higher level of institutional care, or benefits other than waiver of premium, post-confinement, post-acute, or recuperative benefits on prior institutionalization.

headings.title: Labeling requirements for post-confinement benefits
headings.reviewNote: Requires long-term care policies with post-confinement benefits to clearly label limitations and conditions in a separate paragraph.

headings.title: Noninstitutional benefit eligibility conditioning limits
headings.reviewNote: Bars policies or riders conditioning noninstitutional benefits on prior institutional care from requiring a prior institutional stay of more than thirty days.

headings.title: Limit on post-institutionalization admission time conditions
headings.reviewNote: Bars policies or riders paying benefits only following institutionalization from conditioning benefits on admission for the same or related conditions less than thirty days after discharge.

headings.title: Director loss ratio standards for long-term care policies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to adopt loss ratio standards for long-term care policies if the regulation specifically references long-term care insurance policies.

headings.title: Thirty-day right to return and refund
headings.reviewNote: Grants applicants thirty-day free-look right to return policy or certificate for full premium refund.

headings.title: Mandatory unearned premium refund upon cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Requires refund of the unearned premium paid beyond the cancellation month, returned within twenty days of notice, for policies issued, delivered, or renewed on or after January 1, 2011, and allows written or electronic cancellation notice.

headings.title: Actuarial justification limit on rate increases
headings.reviewNote: Bars annual premium rate increases exceeding the amount actuarially justified based on credible experience and the rate basis in effect in this state, without recognition of rates in other states.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires delivery of outline of coverage to long-term care applicants, group certificate contents, policy summaries, and delivery notices.

headings.title: Mandatory outline of coverage delivery timing
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivering an outline of coverage at initial solicitation (before application for agent solicitations; with the application for direct response), in a director-prescribed format, with an exception for group policies.

headings.title: Required contents of outline of coverage
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes outline contents including principal benefits, exclusions, renewability terms, and premium increase rights.

headings.title: Certificate delivery for group long-term care
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivering certificate containing principal benefits and rights to insured persons under group policies.

headings.title: Delivery of approved contract within thirty days
headings.reviewNote: Mandates contract or certificate delivery to applicant within thirty days of application approval.

headings.title: Policy summary for life policies with long-term riders
headings.reviewNote: Requires policy summary detailing death benefits, long-term limits, and cost impacts delivered with life policies.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs rescission of long-term care policies, misrepresentation standards based on time in force, field issuance ban, and non-recovery.

headings.title: Policy rescission within first six months
headings.reviewNote: Allows insurer to rescind policy in force less than six months upon showing misrepresentation material to acceptance.

headings.title: Rescission for policies under two years duration
headings.reviewNote: Permits rescission for policies in force six months to two years upon showing material misrepresentation pertaining to condition.

headings.title: Incontestability after two years except intentional fraud
headings.reviewNote: Bars contesting policies in force two years except upon showing insured knowingly and intentionally misrepresented health facts.

headings.title: Prohibition on field-issued policies based on health
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits agents or third-party administrators from field-issuing policies based on health or medical status.

headings.title: Non-recovery of paid benefits upon policy rescission
headings.reviewNote: Provides that paid long-term care benefits cannot be recovered by insurer upon policy rescission.

headings.title: Life insurance accelerated benefit contestability rules
headings.reviewNote: Applies standard life contestability to remaining death benefits upon insured's death while applying section to accelerated benefits.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires mandatory offer of nonforfeiture benefit options, contingent lapse protections upon rate spikes, group offers, and rulemaking.

headings.title: Mandatory nonforfeiture benefit offer and contingent lapse
headings.reviewNote: Requires offering nonforfeiture benefit option and provides contingent benefit upon lapse following substantial rate increase.

headings.title: Nonforfeiture benefit offers to group certificate holders
headings.reviewNote: Directs nonforfeiture offers to group policyholders or individual proposed certificate holders in non-retirement community groups.

headings.title: Rulemaking for nonforfeiture types and lapse triggers
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to promulgate rules defining nonforfeiture standards and substantial rate increase triggers for contingent lapse.

entries.reviewSummary: Delegates rulemaking authority for premium adequacy, marketing standards, and agent testing, with chapter 536 nonseverability clause.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for premium adequacy and marketing
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to promulgate reasonable rules promoting premium adequacy, policyholder alternatives to substantial rate increases, and minimum standards for marketing, agent testing, penalties, and reporting.

headings.title: Rulemaking procedures and nonseverability clause
headings.reviewNote: Conditions rulemaking validity on chapter 536 compliance and establishes mutual nonseverability of regulatory powers.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits cost-sharing for diagnostic and supplemental breast examinations and coordinates high-deductible health plan rules with federal tax laws.

headings.title: Definitions for breast examination cost-sharing exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Defines cost-sharing requirement, diagnostic breast examination, health benefit plan, and supplemental breast examination.

headings.title: Cost-sharing prohibition for covered breast examinations
headings.reviewNote: Bars health carriers and plans issued, continued, or renewed on or after January 1, 2024 that cover diagnostic or supplemental breast examinations or section 376.782 coverage from imposing cost-sharing requirements.

headings.title: Application to health savings account high-deductible plans
headings.reviewNote: Coordinates cost-sharing prohibition with federal health savings account minimum deductible rules under Section 223.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires direct OB/GYN access, cancer screening notices, osteoporosis coverage, and contraceptive coverage with moral-objection exclusions, enrollee notices, and nondisclosure, with source notes recording an effective date of 10-12-12 and a 2013 federal preemption annotation for certain subsections.

headings.title: Required OB/GYN access, screening notice, osteoporosis, and contraceptive coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires plans on or after January 1, 2002 to provide direct access to participating OB/GYN providers, annual cancer screening notices, osteoporosis coverage, and contraceptive coverage at no charge or at the level of other covered drugs.

headings.title: Definitions of health carrier and benefit plan
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory definitions of health carrier and health benefit plan from section 376.1350 to OB/GYN mandate.

headings.title: Supplemental insurance policy exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts supplemental policies including life care, accident-only, specified disease, fixed daily benefit hospital, Medicare supplement, long-term care, short-term major medical of six months or less, and others the director determines.

headings.title: Moral or religious exclusion of contraceptive coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires carriers to offer plans excluding contraceptives for purchasers with contrary beliefs and to issue exclusion policy forms to enrollees on request, and exempts carriers controlled by entities with contrary tenets (source note: subsections 1(4), 4, 5, 6(1)-(3) are annotated as federally preempted).

headings.title: Independent enrollee purchase of contraceptive coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires carriers, other than exempted carriers, to allow enrollees in plans excluding contraceptive coverage under subsection 4 to purchase a plan that includes contraceptive coverage.

headings.title: Written notices on contraceptive and abortion coverage rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires clear and conspicuous written notice on enrollment materials stating whether contraceptive coverage is included, enrollee rights to exclude or purchase it, whether an elective abortion rider was purchased, and the right to exclude elective abortion coverage.

headings.title: Confidentiality of enrollee contraceptive purchase choices
headings.reviewNote: Bars carriers from disclosing to the plan purchaser the names of enrollees who exclude or purchase contraceptive coverage, and bars discrimination against enrollees for those choices.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority of health and insurance departments
headings.reviewNote: Allows the departments of health and senior services and commerce and insurance to promulgate rules to implement this section, effective only if compliant with chapter 536, with a nonseverability clause.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires health policies to offer coverage for dose-intensive chemotherapy and stem cell transplants for breast cancer, setting cost limits.

headings.title: Mandatory offer of dose-intensive chemotherapy coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires policies to offer coverage for breast cancer dose-intensive chemotherapy and autologous stem cell transplants.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity and lifetime maximum benefit
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits greater deductibles and permits lifetime benefit maximum of not less than one hundred thousand dollars.

headings.title: Managed care contracts and patient hold-harmless
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes preferred provider networks and requires provider hold-harmless terms if care fails protocol standards.

headings.title: Exemption for short-term and limited policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts accident-only, travel, specified disease, and short-term nonrenewable policies under seven months from offer mandate.

headings.title: Standard coverage inclusion permitted by carriers
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that nothing in the section prohibits an entity from including all or part of these services as standard coverage in its policies, contracts, or plans.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates health coverage for prosthetic devices and reconstructive breast surgery following mastectomy without imposing time limits.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for prosthetics and reconstructive surgery
headings.reviewNote: Requires health policies covering mastectomies to cover reconstructive surgery and prosthetics without time limitations.

headings.title: Definition of mastectomy for insurance coverage
headings.reviewNote: Defines mastectomy as medically necessary partial or complete removal of the breast determined by a licensed physician.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental and limited benefit policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts life care, accident-only, specified disease, hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and long-term care policies.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates forty-eight hour vaginal and ninety-six hour cesarean inpatient maternity coverage, shorter-stay criteria, post-discharge visits, cost-sharing parity, a bar on physician retaliation, and rulemaking.

headings.title: Mandatory inpatient hospital maternity care stays
headings.reviewNote: Requires forty-eight hour vaginal and ninety-six hour cesarean minimum hospital coverage for mothers and newborns.

headings.title: Shorter maternity stays upon physician approval
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes shorter stays when approved by attending physician consulting mother, conditioned on post-discharge care.

headings.title: Post-discharge care visits and home assessments
headings.reviewNote: Requires minimum two post-discharge visits including one home visit for maternal and neonatal physical assessments.

headings.title: Definition of attending physician for maternity
headings.reviewNote: Defines attending physician to include obstetricians, pediatricians, or other physicians attending mother or child.

headings.title: Written notice of maternity coverage required
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice describing statutory maternity benefits provided to policyholders upon policy delivery.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity for maternity services
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the required health care service is not subject to any greater deductible or co-payment than other similar health care services under the policy, contract, or plan.

headings.title: Prohibited retaliation against attending physician
headings.reviewNote: Bars insurers from financial disincentives, deselection, termination, added documentation or utilization review, payment reductions, or other penalties against the attending physician solely for ordering care consistent with this section.

headings.title: Insurance department rules to implement maternity coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department of commerce and insurance to adopt rules to implement and enforce this section, effective only if promulgated pursuant to section 536.024.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates childhood immunization coverage for children birth to age five without cost-sharing and caps provider vaccine charges.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for childhood immunizations
headings.reviewNote: Requires specified health coverage entities to cover immunizations of a child from birth to five years of age as provided by department of health and senior services regulations.

headings.title: Cost-sharing prohibited for required immunizations
headings.reviewNote: Provides that immunization coverage is not subject to any deductible or co-payment limits.

headings.title: Health maintenance organization designated provider option
headings.reviewNote: Allows a health maintenance organization contract to cover required benefits only if rendered by a designated, affiliated provider, while requiring compliance with immunization requirements of state or federally funded health programs as a condition of participation.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental insurance policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts supplemental policies including life care, accident-only, specified disease, fixed daily benefit hospital, Medicare supplement, long-term care, liability supplement, short-term major medical of six months or less, and others the department determines.

headings.title: Health department rulemaking for covered vaccines
headings.reviewNote: Directs department of health and senior services to promulgate rules specifying required covered immunizations.

headings.title: Limitation on provider charges for immunizations
headings.reviewNote: Caps provider charges for administering immunizations at one hundred percent of reasonable and customary fees.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates early intervention service coverage for children enrolled in Part C First Steps, setting payment caps and cost-sharing parity.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for First Steps children
headings.reviewNote: Requires non-Medicaid plans on or after January 1, 2006 to cover early intervention services by licensed professionals for children from birth to age three eligible under Part C, limited to three thousand dollars per child per policy per year and nine thousand dollars per child.

headings.title: Definitions of health carrier and plan
headings.reviewNote: Adopts statutory definitions of health carrier and health benefit plan from section 376.1350 for First Steps early intervention coverage.

headings.title: Lead agency responsibility if coverage is preempted or invalid
headings.reviewNote: Makes the lead agency responsible for payment and provision of benefits if a plan is not required to provide coverage due to federal preemption such as ERISA or if subsection 1 is found unconstitutional.

headings.title: Definition of early intervention services
headings.reviewNote: Defines early intervention services as medically necessary speech and language, occupational, and physical therapy and assistive technology devices for eligible children from birth to age three, including services under an active individualized family service plan.

headings.title: Medicaid-rate billing, lifetime maximum exclusion, and claims timing
headings.reviewNote: Bars applying early intervention payments against lifetime aggregate maximums if the carrier satisfies obligations under subsection 7(2), requires billing at the Medicaid rate, and requires claims payment under sections 376.383 and 376.384 beginning January 1, 2007.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity with physical health conditions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits greater deductibles, co-payments, or coinsurance than other similar health care services provided by the health benefit plan.

headings.title: Premium-based payment cap and optional direct payment
headings.reviewNote: Caps annual carrier payments to the Part C system at one-half of one percent of direct written premium, and permits direct payment by January thirty-first of the lesser of that amount or five hundred thousand dollars in full satisfaction.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental and limited policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts supplemental policies including life care, specified disease, fixed daily benefit hospital, Medicare supplement, hospitalization-surgical, individually underwritten, long-term care, and short-term major medical policies of six months or less.

headings.title: Insurance department data collection and annual report
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department of commerce and insurance to collect data on children covered and amounts paid, except for carriers paying under subsection 7(2), and report to the general assembly by January 30, 2007 and annually thereafter.

headings.title: Exemption from statutory sunset review provisions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the statutory early intervention insurance coverage mandate shall not sunset under section 23.253.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires health policies to cover formula and low-protein foods for children under six with phenylketonuria, setting cost limits.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for PKU formula and food
headings.reviewNote: Requires health coverage for physician-recommended formula and low-protein foods for children under six with metabolic diseases.

headings.title: Definition of low-protein modified food products
headings.reviewNote: Defines low-protein modified food products as specially formulated foods containing less than one gram of protein.

headings.title: Permitted cost-sharing and annual benefit caps
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes up to fifty percent coinsurance and minimum five-thousand-dollar annual benefit maximum per child.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental insurance policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts life care, accident-only, specified disease, hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and long-term care policies from PKU mandate.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates health coverage for newborn hearing screenings, rescreening, and amplification, cost-sharing parity, and Medicaid coverage.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for newborn hearing screening
headings.reviewNote: Requires health policies to cover newborn hearing screenings, rescreenings, audiological assessments, and initial amplification.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity with similar services
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits subjecting newborn hearing screening to greater deductibles or co-payments than similar services.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental and short-term policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts accident-only, specified disease, hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and short-term major medical policies.

headings.title: Hearing screening coverage under Medicaid programs
headings.reviewNote: Requires newborn hearing screening and amplification coverage for children receiving Medicaid and children's health benefits.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates scalp prostheses coverage for children under eighteen with alopecia under Medicaid and state plans, setting benefit amounts.

headings.title: Mandatory scalp prostheses coverage for children
headings.reviewNote: Requires Medicaid, the children's health insurance program, and Missouri consolidated health care plan coverage on or after January 1, 2004 to cover prostheses and scalp hair prostheses for alopecia areata or alopecia totalis for persons eighteen or younger.

headings.title: Definitions of prostheses and scalp prostheses
headings.reviewNote: Defines prostheses as artificial appliances replacing natural structures and scalp hair prostheses as custom hair substitutes.

headings.title: Annual and lifetime maximum benefit amounts
headings.reviewNote: Limits required coverage to two hundred dollars per calendar year or a lifetime maximum of three thousand two hundred dollars for a more permanent scalp prosthesis, expiring when benefits reach that amount or the person reaches eighteen.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity with other health services
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits greater deductibles or co-payments for scalp prostheses than applied to similar covered health services.

headings.title: Greater coverage permitted by health plans
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that health plans are not prohibited from offering greater coverage than required by this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines terms and requires coverage for autism spectrum disorder and developmental or physical disability diagnosis and treatment, with treatment plan review, applied behavior analysis limits, reimbursement, plan applicability, and exemptions.

headings.title: Definitions for autism and developmental disability coverage
headings.reviewNote: Defines applied behavior analysis, autism service provider, autism spectrum disorders, and developmental or physical disability.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for autism and developmental disorders
headings.reviewNote: Requires health benefit plans to provide coverage for diagnosis and treatment of autism and developmental disabilities.

headings.title: Prohibited discrimination and nonrenewal for autism
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits health carriers from denying coverage, refusing contracts, or terminating plans due to autism or developmental conditions.

headings.title: Treatment plan requirement and review limits
headings.reviewNote: Limits coverage to medically necessary treatment ordered by the treating licensed physician or psychologist under a treatment plan, specifies plan elements on request, and limits carrier plan review to once every six months absent agreement, with review costs borne by the plan or carrier.

headings.title: Applied behavior analysis maximum benefit and visit limits
headings.reviewNote: Subjects applied behavior analysis to a forty-thousand-dollar annual maximum for individuals through age eighteen (exceedable on prior approval if medically necessary), requires inflation adjustment at least triennially with annual director calculation, and bars visit limits except through that maximum.

headings.title: Therapeutic care visit limits with prior approval
headings.reviewNote: Permits limiting therapeutic care for developmental or physical disabilities to a number of visits per calendar year, with coverage beyond the limit upon prior plan approval if medically necessary.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity and permitted general exclusions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the section does not limit otherwise available benefits, bars greater deductibles, coinsurance, or co-payments than other physical health care, permits general contract exclusions and utilization review, and bars denial because treatment is educational or habilitative.

headings.title: Payees for applied behavior analysis reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Requires applied behavior analysis payments to go to the autism service provider or the entity or group for whom the supervising board-certified behavior analyst works, including line therapist services in the treatment plan that are medically necessary.

headings.title: Carrier nonliability for line therapist actions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that health carriers shall not be held liable for the actions of line therapists in the performance of their duties, notwithstanding other law.

headings.title: Application to state consolidated health care plans
headings.reviewNote: Extends autism and developmental disability coverage mandates to state employee plans under chapter 103.

headings.title: Application to self-insured and multiple employer plans
headings.reviewNote: Applies the section to plans established, extended, modified, or renewed on or after January 1, 2020, including self-insured governmental plans, self-insured group arrangements, multiple employer welfare arrangements, and self-insured school district plans, to the extent permitted.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental and limited policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts supplemental policies including life care, accident-only, specified disease, fixed daily benefit hospital, Medicare supplement, long-term care, and short-term major medical policies, and exempts certain individually underwritten plans issued before January 1, 2011 (autism) or plans issued before January 1, 2014 (developmental or physical disability).

headings.title: No reimbursement duplicating Part C or school billing
headings.reviewNote: Relieves a carrier from reimbursing applied behavior analysis to the extent it is billed by a Part C early intervention program or school district, without affecting obligations under individualized plans or section 376.1218.

headings.title: Prompt pay and grievance statutes applicable
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 376.383, 376.384, and 376.1350 to 376.1399 to this section.

headings.title: Inapplicability of section to Mo HealthNet
headings.reviewNote: Exempts Missouri Medicaid and Mo HealthNet programs from the statutory provisions of this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates health coverage for hospital charges and general anesthesia for dental procedures for young children and disabled persons.

headings.title: Mandatory anesthesia coverage for hospital dental care
headings.reviewNote: Requires coverage for general anesthesia and hospital charges for dental care for covered children under five, severely disabled persons, and persons whose medical or behavioral condition requires hospitalization or general anesthesia for dental care.

headings.title: Coverage regardless of hospital, surgical center, or office
headings.reviewNote: Requires coverage for general anesthesia and hospital or office charges for treatment rendered by a dentist regardless of whether provided in a participating hospital, surgical center, or office.

headings.title: Prior authorization permitted for dental hospitalizations
headings.reviewNote: Allows health carriers to require prior authorization for hospital dental admissions on same basis as medical conditions.

headings.title: Exemption for dental-only and supplemental policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts dental-only, accident-only, specified disease, Medicare supplement, and short-term major medical policies.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits dental plan contracts from capping dentist fees for non-covered dental services and defines statutory terms.

headings.title: Prohibition on fee caps for non-covered dental care
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits dental plan contracts from requiring dentists to provide non-covered services at carrier-fixed fee rates.

headings.title: Definitions of covered services and dental plans
headings.reviewNote: Defines covered services, dental plan, health benefit plan, and health carrier for fee schedule limitations.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates health coverage for hearing aids for children under eighteen matching Medicaid benefits, subject to state appropriations.

headings.title: Definitions for childhood hearing aid coverage
headings.reviewNote: Adopts definitions of health carrier, health benefit plan, and hearing aid from cross-referenced statutes.

headings.title: Mandatory hearing aid coverage matching Medicaid
headings.reviewNote: Requires health benefit plans to cover childhood hearing aids to at least the extent covered under MO HealthNet.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental and limited policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts life care, accident-only, specified disease, Medicare supplement, and short-term major medical policies.

headings.title: State appropriation condition and federal nondiscrimination voidance
headings.reviewNote: Makes additional state costs subject to appropriation and voids the section if a federal agency determines it violates 42 U.S.C. Section 18116 relating to nondiscrimination.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates coverage for chiropractic care within network for twenty-six visits, cost-sharing parity, and individual underwriting exemptions.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for network chiropractic care
headings.reviewNote: Requires health policies to cover chiropractic care within network up to twenty-six visits per policy period.

headings.title: Parity of financial terms with physical health care
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits imposing greater financial burdens or cost-sharing on chiropractic care than other physical health conditions.

headings.title: Exemption for individually underwritten health plans
headings.reviewNote: Exempts individually underwritten health plans and insurance contracts from chiropractic coverage mandate.

headings.title: Inapplicability of section to Medicaid programs
headings.reviewNote: Provides that chiropractic coverage requirements do not apply to benefits provided under Medicaid.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental insurance policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts life care, accident-only, specified disease, hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and long-term care policies from chiropractic mandate.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires health carriers to offer coverage for prosthetic devices and services, establishing parity with basic health care services.

headings.title: Mandatory offer of prosthetic device coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires health carriers to offer coverage for physician-prescribed original and replacement prosthetic devices and services.

headings.title: Definitions of health carrier and benefit plan
headings.reviewNote: Adopts definitions of health carrier and health benefit plan from section 376.1350 for prosthetic device coverage mandate.

headings.title: Benefit maximums and cost-sharing parity
headings.reviewNote: Requires benefit maximums and cost-sharing for prosthetics to match common terms applied to basic health care services.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental and limited policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts life care, accident-only, specified disease, hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and long-term care policies from prosthetic coverage.

entries.reviewSummary: Bars physical and occupational therapy co-payments or coinsurance exceeding primary care office visits, requires clear coverage statements, and directs a 2016 actuarial analysis, with source notes recording effective dates and a veto override.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity with primary care visits
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits health carriers from charging higher co-payments or coinsurance for physical or occupational therapy than primary care.

headings.title: Clear statement of therapy coverage and limitations
headings.reviewNote: Requires a health carrier or plan to clearly state the availability of physical therapy and occupational therapy coverage and all related limitations, conditions, and exclusions.

headings.title: Actuarial analysis of occupational therapy coverage cost
headings.reviewNote: Directs the oversight division of the joint committee on legislative research to analyze the cost impact of occupational therapy coverage beginning September 1, 2016, report by December 31, 2016, and waives the analysis if the fiscal note estimate is lower than its cost.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires coverage for refilling prescription eye drops before the last day of the prescribed dosage period when the prescribing provider authorizes it, with cost-sharing parity and exemptions.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for early eye drop refills
headings.reviewNote: Requires health plans covering eye drops to cover early refills prior to dosage expiration upon provider authorization.

headings.title: Definitions of carrier and health plan
headings.reviewNote: Adopts definitions of health carrier and health benefit plan set forth in section 376.1350.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity for eye drop refills
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits subjecting early eye drop refills to greater deductibles or co-payments than other covered prescription services.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental and short-term policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts life care, accident-only, specified disease, hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and short-term policies.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires health plans to cover extended dispensing of self-administered hormonal contraceptives, phasing from ninety days to one year.

headings.title: Definitions for self-administered hormonal contraceptives
headings.reviewNote: Defines self-administered hormonal contraceptive as FDA-approved birth control drugs while excluding emergency contraceptives.

headings.title: Extended dispensing supplies phased coverage mandate
headings.reviewNote: Requires plans covering self-administered hormonal contraceptives to reimburse dispensing of up to a ninety-day supply (up to one hundred eighty days for generics) in 2026, and up to a one-year supply beginning January 1, 2027.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity with similar health services
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits subjecting extended contraceptive supplies to greater deductibles or co-payments than similar covered services.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits health carriers from imposing time limits or excluding anesthesia time when calculating payment for anesthesia services.

headings.title: Definitions regarding anesthesia service payments
headings.reviewNote: Defines anesthesia time, anesthesia time units, excepted benefit plan, health carrier, and anesthesia payment terms.

headings.title: Prohibition against anesthesia payment time limits
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits carriers and health plans from imposing duration-based time limits on payment for anesthesia services.

headings.title: Exclusion of anesthesia time prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Bars carriers from adopting policies that restrict or exclude all anesthesia time when calculating service payments.

headings.title: Application to excepted benefit health plans
headings.reviewNote: Applies anesthesia payment protection requirements to short-term major medical excepted benefit plans.

headings.title: Exemption for dental and maxillofacial anesthesia
headings.reviewNote: Exempts anesthesia services provided in connection with dental or oral and maxillofacial surgery under chapter 332.

headings.title: Scope of practice and contract limitations
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies provider licensing scope limitations, utilization review compliance, and prospective application to contracts.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires coverage for pelvic examination and pap smear, prostate, and colorectal cancer screening of nonsymptomatic persons per American Cancer Society guidelines, with exemptions, physician advice before breast implantation, and preservation of legal remedies.

headings.title: Mandatory cancer screening coverage requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires health policies and plans to cover pelvic examinations, pap smears, prostate exams, and colorectal screenings.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity for cancer screenings
headings.reviewNote: Requires cancer screening coverage terms to be at least as favorable as general medical benefits.

headings.title: Exemption of limited benefit insurance policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts accident-only, hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and long-term care policies from screening mandates.

headings.title: Exemption for short-term major medical policies
headings.reviewNote: Excludes short-term major medical insurance policies of six months or less duration from cancer screening rules.

headings.title: Physician advice prior to breast implantation
headings.reviewNote: Directs attending physicians to advise patients of risks including cancer associated with breast implant procedures.

headings.title: Preservation of legal remedies and rights
headings.reviewNote: Provides that cancer screening provisions do not alter, impair, or affect other statutory claims and remedies.

entries.reviewSummary: Guarantees cancer patients the right to second opinions by specialists and mandates insurance coverage under standard policy terms.

headings.title: Patient right to cancer second opinion referral
headings.reviewNote: Requires attending physicians to inform cancer patients of referral rights to board-certified specialists or nonnetwork providers.

headings.title: Mandatory health coverage for cancer second opinions
headings.reviewNote: Requires health carriers to cover second opinions by cancer specialists subject to standard deductible and coinsurance terms.

headings.title: Exemption of supplemental and short-term policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts supplemental, accident-only, fixed daily hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and short-term policies from mandate.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes cost-sharing and prior authorization parity for orally administered anticancer medications compared to injected drugs.

headings.title: Definitions for anticancer medication parity provisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines anticancer medications, covered person, and health benefit plan (by cross-reference to section 376.1350) for purposes of the section.

headings.title: Coverage parity between oral and injected cancer drugs
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits less favorable terms or cost-sharing for oral anticancer medications than for intravenously injected medications.

headings.title: Prior authorization and out-of-pocket parity
headings.reviewNote: Bars restricting oral anticancer medications with prior authorizations or out-of-pocket limits not applicable to injectables.

headings.title: Reclassification or increase of cost-sharing prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits a plan from reclassifying or increasing cost-sharing for anticancer medications to achieve compliance and applies any out-of-pocket increase to the majority of comparable benefits.

headings.title: Safe harbor monthly cost-sharing cap
headings.reviewNote: Deems plans compliant if total cost-sharing is no more than seventy-five dollars per thirty-day supply of an oral anticancer medication, and allows annual adjustment not exceeding the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers Midwest Region.

headings.title: Application to high deductible health plans
headings.reviewNote: Delays application of seventy-five dollar monthly cap for high deductible plans until the annual deductible is met.

headings.title: Effective date of anticancer medication parity
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that statutory anticancer medication parity provisions become effective January 1, 2015.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires health coverage for bone marrow donor human leukocyte antigen testing at accredited labs, capped at seventy-five dollars.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for bone marrow antigen testing
headings.reviewNote: Requires coverage of human leukocyte antigen testing for bone marrow transplantation at accredited facilities with informed consent, and permits limiting each enrollee to one test per lifetime reimbursed at no more than seventy-five dollars.

headings.title: Definitions of health carrier and plan terms
headings.reviewNote: Adopts definitions of health carrier and health benefit plan from section 376.1350 for bone marrow testing mandate.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity for antigen testing services
headings.reviewNote: Bars imposing greater deductibles or co-payments on bone marrow antigen testing than other similar health care services.

headings.title: Supplemental and limited policy exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts life care, accident-only, specified disease, Medicare supplement, and short-term policies from testing requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits health benefit plans from favoring opioids over prescribed nonopioid medications for acute or chronic pain management.

headings.title: Definitions regarding pain medications and health plans
headings.reviewNote: Defines acute pain, chronic pain, enrollee, health benefit plan, and health care professional.

headings.title: Prohibited plan practices favoring opioid medications
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits denying coverage, step therapy fail-first opioid requirements, or higher cost-sharing for prescribed nonopioids.

headings.title: Applicability date for pain medication protections
headings.reviewNote: Applies nonopioid pain medication coverage rules to health benefit plans delivered or renewed on or after January 1, 2027.

headings.title: Prerequisite conditions for acute pain nonopioid rules
headings.reviewNote: Conditions acute pain provisions on FDA approval of multiple nonopioid medications indicated for acute pain.

headings.title: Prerequisite conditions for chronic pain nonopioid rules
headings.reviewNote: Conditions chronic pain provisions on FDA approval of multiple nonopioid medications indicated for chronic pain.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires entities to offer coverage for lead poisoning testing of pregnant women and testing authorized under sections 701.340 to 701.349, with cost-sharing parity, no reduction of coverage, and exemptions.

headings.title: Mandatory offer of lead poisoning testing coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires specified health coverage entities to offer coverage for lead poisoning testing of pregnant women and testing authorized under sections 701.340 to 701.349 or related department rules.

headings.title: Cost-sharing parity for lead poisoning testing
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits imposing greater deductibles or co-payments on lead testing than other medical services in the plan.

headings.title: Prohibition on reducing other plan benefits
headings.reviewNote: Forbids health carriers and managed care delivery entities from reducing or eliminating existing coverage to offset lead testing.

headings.title: Exemption for limited benefit insurance policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts accident-only, specified disease, hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and long-term care policies from lead testing.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates mutual life insurance company reorganization into mutual holding company structures and policyholder voting approval.

headings.title: Director review and approval of reorganization plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires a reorganizing mutual life insurer to form a mutual holding company and file a plan with the director, who reviews it, may retain consultants at applicant expense and hold a hearing, approves if fair and equitable, and may condition approval on modifications.

headings.title: Policyholder approval and meeting notice requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires majority approval of policyholders voting at a special meeting and allows groups of 100 members to mail materials.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs member interest, nontransferability, liability immunity, assessment prohibitions, and non-security status in mutual holding companies.

headings.title: Membership interest conversion to holding company
headings.reviewNote: Converts policyholder membership interests in reorganized life insurer into membership interests in mutual holding company.

headings.title: Prohibition on transfer of membership rights
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits members of mutual holding companies from transferring membership or rights arising from company membership.

headings.title: Immunity from personal liability for company obligations
headings.reviewNote: Provides that mutual holding company members are not personally liable for company acts, debts, or liabilities.

headings.title: Prohibition on member assessments and levies
headings.reviewNote: Bars directors or members from imposing any assessments on mutual holding company members for liabilities or corporate acts.

headings.title: Non-security classification of membership interests
headings.reviewNote: Provides that membership interests in domestic mutual holding companies do not constitute securities under state law.

entries.reviewSummary: Subjects mutual holding companies to department supervision, insolvency proceedings, and demutualization statutory procedures.

headings.title: Director supervision and insolvency proceeding status
headings.reviewNote: Subjects mutual holding company to director supervision and makes it a party in insurer rehabilitation or liquidation.

headings.title: Demutualization rules for for-profit mutual life insurers
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 375.201 to 375.226 to demutualization of a mutual holding company as if it were a mutual life insurer, but not to companies organized under chapter 354 or 355 and only to for-profit mutual life insurers.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates health carrier provider payment methods, prohibiting fee-based reimbursement without consent and governing overpayment recoupments.

headings.title: Definitions for provider reimbursement method regulations
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory definitions from section 376.1350 to provider reimbursement method rules unless context indicates otherwise.

headings.title: Fee-based reimbursement method restrictions prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits health carriers from restricting provider reimbursement to payment methods requiring fees, discounts, or remuneration.

headings.title: Provider notice and consent for fee-based payments
headings.reviewNote: Requires carrier to obtain provider approval before using fee-based reimbursement and establishes provider opt-out procedures.

headings.title: Provider right to ACH electronic funds transfer
headings.reviewNote: Requires health carriers to permit providers to select Automated Clearing House electronic funds transfer reimbursement.

headings.title: Restrictions on overpayment recoupment procedures
headings.reviewNote: Restricts overpayment collection to the original payee and mandates detailed notice identifying service, date, and patient.

headings.title: Violations deemed unfair trade practices
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a violation of this section is deemed an unfair trade practice under sections 375.930 to 375.948.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires health carriers conducting utilization review to maintain a written program and file annual activity reports with the director.

headings.title: Written utilization review program requirements
headings.reviewNote: Directs health carriers conducting utilization review to implement written programs describing delegated and nondelegated activities.

headings.title: Annual utilization review program report filing
headings.reviewNote: Requires health carriers to file annual reports detailing utilization review program activities with insurance director.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes comprehensive operational, clinical criteria, personnel qualification, oversight, and appeal standards for utilization review.

headings.title: Documented clinical review criteria standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires utilization programs to use evidence-based clinical criteria evaluated periodically and made available to departments.

headings.title: Medical director qualifications and clinical peer review
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that medical directors be Missouri licensed professionals and adverse determinations evaluated by clinical peers.

headings.title: Timely decision procedures and consistent criterion application
headings.reviewNote: Requires carriers to issue timely utilization decisions, obtain pertinent clinical data, and ensure consistent criterion use.

headings.title: Utilization data management system requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires carrier data systems to adequately support review activities and generate necessary management monitoring reports.

headings.title: Oversight of delegated utilization review organizations
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes health carrier oversight responsibilities including written program descriptions, approvals, and performance audits.

headings.title: Coordination with medical management functions
headings.reviewNote: Directs health carriers to coordinate utilization review with quality assurance, credentialing, contracting, and grievances.

headings.title: Toll-free telephone access to review personnel
headings.reviewNote: Requires health carriers to provide enrollees and providers timely toll-free telephone access to utilization review staff.

headings.title: Limitation to necessary clinical review information
headings.reviewNote: Limits carrier data collection during review to information necessary to certify admission, treatment, frequency, and duration.

headings.title: Prohibited financial incentives for review decisions
headings.reviewNote: Bars review compensation arrangements containing direct or indirect incentives to render adverse or inappropriate determinations.

headings.title: Right to appeal prescription and equipment determinations
headings.reviewNote: Permits enrollees or providers to appeal adverse coverage decisions for medically necessary pharmaceuticals and durable equipment.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for off-label prescription drugs
headings.reviewNote: Requires drug coverage for uses of FDA-approved drugs recognized in standard reference compendia or accepted peer-reviewed literature and medically appropriate, with exceptions for contraindicated uses, free research trial drugs, and nonformulary drugs.

headings.title: Issuance of prior authorization confirmation numbers
headings.reviewNote: Requires a carrier to issue a confirmation number to an enrollee when it authorizes provision of health care services through a participating provider or other authorized representative.

headings.title: Restrictions on retroactively retracting authorizations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits carriers from retracting authorizations or reducing payment after services are provided in reliance on approval, except for material misrepresentation or omission or termination of the plan or the person's coverage before services are provided.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets procedural timeframes for prospective, concurrent, and retrospective utilization reviews, adverse determination notices, and prior authorizations.

headings.title: Written utilization review procedures and enrollee representation
headings.reviewNote: Requires carriers to maintain written procedures for review determinations and confirms enrollees may act via representatives.

headings.title: Timeframes for prospective review determinations and notice
headings.reviewNote: Establishes thirty-six hour deadline for prospective determinations and specifies required telephonic and written notices.

headings.title: Concurrent review timeframes and coverage during notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires concurrent determinations within one working day and continues covered care without enrollee liability until notification.

headings.title: Retrospective review deadlines and written enrollee notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires retrospective review determinations within thirty working days of receiving all necessary information and written notice of the determination to the enrollee within ten working days of making it.

headings.title: Required clinical rationale in adverse determination notices
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that adverse determination notices include specific clinical rationales, review criteria, and appeal instructions.

headings.title: Written procedures for missing review information
headings.reviewNote: Requires written procedures, available on the carrier's website or provider portal, for a provider's or enrollee's failure or inability to provide necessary information, and permits denying certification if information will not be released.

headings.title: Forty-five day restriction on modifying prior authorizations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits a utilization review entity from revoking, limiting, conditioning, or otherwise restricting a prior authorization within forty-five working days of the provider's receipt, provided the patient is an enrollee.

headings.title: Billing protections for authorized services and cost-sharing
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits billing enrollees for authorized services beyond standard plan cost-sharing applied toward annual out-of-pocket limits.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes prior authorization electronic processes, API interoperability standards, annual public reporting, and claim scope reductions.

headings.title: Unique confirmation numbers for prior authorizations
headings.reviewNote: Requires utilization review entities to issue unique confirmation numbers upon receiving prior authorization requests.

headings.title: Electronic drug prior authorization and online process standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires utilization review entities by January 1, 2021 to accept drug prior authorization requests through NCPDP SCRIPT secure electronic transmission, and requires carriers beginning July 1, 2028 to maintain an online process with specified features, fee and data-access limits, and a consequence for noncompliance.

headings.title: Electronic prior authorization for general health services
headings.reviewNote: Directs utilization review entities to accept and respond electronically to prior authorizations for medical and mental health care.

headings.title: Implementation of prior authorization application programming interface
headings.reviewNote: Requires carriers and review entities to implement prior authorization application programming interfaces complying with federal rules.

headings.title: Provider utilization of prior authorization API
headings.reviewNote: Permits health care providers to use prior authorization application programming interfaces to submit authorization requests.

headings.title: Contract provisions regarding provider prior authorization API
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes provider contracts to mandate API submissions while protecting enrollee cost-sharing from noncompliance penalties.

headings.title: Public website publication of prior authorization statistics
headings.reviewNote: Requires health carriers to publish detailed annual statistics on prior authorization approval, denial, and appeal timeframes.

headings.title: Annual reporting of services requiring prior authorization
headings.reviewNote: Directs health carriers to report annually a comprehensive inventory of health services requiring prior authorization.

headings.title: Department compilation and scope reduction mandate
headings.reviewNote: Requires carriers to reduce prior authorization scope and directs department to publish annual comparative summary reports.

headings.title: Aggregated annual data reporting on review outcomes
headings.reviewNote: Mandates annual submission of aggregated data on prior authorization volume, approvals, denials, appeals, and top denial reasons.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs informal reconsideration of adverse utilization review determinations between treating providers and reviewers.

headings.title: Provider right to request adverse determination reconsideration
headings.reviewNote: Affords treating provider opportunity to request reconsideration on behalf of enrollee following adverse review determination.

headings.title: One-day timeframe for provider reconsideration discussions
headings.reviewNote: Requires reconsideration within one working day between treating provider and adverse reviewer or designated clinical peer.

headings.title: Right to formal appeal without mandatory reconsideration
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that reconsideration is not a prerequisite to standard or expedited appeal if disagreements remain unresolved.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires utilization review disclosures in plan handbooks, cards, and online portals, and sixty-day notice for criteria changes.

headings.title: Utilization review disclosures in coverage certificates
headings.reviewNote: Requires clear descriptions of utilization review procedures and enrollee rights in coverage certificates and member handbooks.

headings.title: Summary of review procedures for prospective enrollees
headings.reviewNote: Directs health carriers to provide summaries of utilization review procedures in materials intended for prospective enrollees.

headings.title: Toll-free telephone number printed on membership cards
headings.reviewNote: Requires health carriers to print toll-free telephone contact numbers for utilization review decisions on membership cards.

headings.title: Website publication and sixty-day notice for changes
headings.reviewNote: Mandates posting clinical criteria on websites and giving providers sixty days advance notice of prior authorization amendments.
