headings.reviewNote: Applies life insurance disclosure statutes to all solicitations in Missouri by commercial insurers and fraternal benefit societies.

headings.title: Exemptions for annuities, credit life, group, and variable
headings.reviewNote: Exempts annuities, credit life, group life, ERISA pension life policies, and variable life insurance from disclosure rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates pre-sale delivery of buyer's guides and policy summaries, ten-day free look alternatives, and small policy statement rules.

headings.title: Pre-sale delivery of buyer's guide and policy summary
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivery of buyer's guide and policy summary prior to premium acceptance unless ten-day refund right is provided.

headings.title: Delivery of disclosure documents upon prospective buyer request
headings.reviewNote: Directs life insurers to furnish buyer's guides and policy summaries upon request to any prospective insurance purchaser.

headings.title: Abbreviated disclosure statements for small life policies
headings.reviewNote: Permits simplified disclosure statements for life policies with death benefits not exceeding five thousand dollars.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates life sales presentations, agent disclosures, three-year file retention, and time-value-of-money cost comparisons.

headings.title: Three-year file retention of authorized sales materials
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers to keep home office files of all authorized life sales materials for three years following last use.

headings.title: Mandatory agent identity and company affiliation disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Directs insurance agents to disclose their status and full insurer corporate name prior to sales presentations.

headings.title: Restrictions on financial advisor and consultant titles
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits agents from implying independent financial advisory roles unless compensation is genuinely unrelated to sales.

headings.title: Mandatory statement on non-guaranteed policy dividends
headings.reviewNote: Requires any presentation referencing policy dividends to include a clear statement that dividends are not guaranteed.

headings.title: Interest adjustments required for policy cost comparisons
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits comparing life policy costs without recognizing the time value of money through interest adjustments.

headings.title: Separate display of guaranteed and non-guaranteed benefits
headings.reviewNote: Bars displaying guaranteed and non-guaranteed benefits as a single combined sum in sales presentations.

headings.title: Explanation required for life insurance cost indexes
headings.reviewNote: Requires explanatory statements that life insurance cost indexes are useful only for comparing similar policy types.

headings.title: Current dividend scale disclosures with cost indexes
headings.reviewNote: Requires statements that cost indexes reflecting dividends are based on current company scales and not guaranteed.

headings.title: Maximum premium definition for adjustable rate policies
headings.reviewNote: Defines the annual premium as the maximum possible annual rate for policies where the insurer may alter premiums.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Missouri Life and Health Insurance Guaranty Association Act to protect policyholders against insurer insolvencies.

headings.title: Title cited as Guaranty Association Act
headings.reviewNote: Cites sections 376.715 to 376.758 as the Missouri Life and Health Insurance Guaranty Association Act.

headings.title: Purpose to protect policyholders against insurer insolvencies
headings.reviewNote: States legislative purpose to protect policyholders from contract defaults caused by member insurer impairments or insolvencies.

headings.title: Creation of association and assessment of members
headings.reviewNote: Creates guaranty association of member insurers funded by member assessments to discharge unpaid insurer liabilities.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines guaranty association coverages, residency requirements, exclusions, and aggregate benefit limits up to five million dollars.

headings.title: Persons covered under guaranty association protections
headings.reviewNote: Extends coverage to Missouri residents, nonresidents under specific conditions, and structured settlement payees.

headings.title: Covered policy types and statutory exclusions
headings.reviewNote: Provides coverage for direct nongroup life and health insurance (including health maintenance organization contracts), annuities and supplemental contracts, and certificates under direct group policies, subject to the section's limits.

headings.title: Exclusion of nonguaranteed and unallocated contractual terms
headings.reviewNote: Bars coverage for contract portions not guaranteed, unallocated annuities, and rates of interest exceeding statutory limits.

headings.title: Per-life benefit limits for insurers placed in rehabilitation before 2013
headings.reviewNote: Limits association liability, for insurers first placed under rehabilitation or liquidation before August 28, 2013, to contractual obligations or per-life caps of three hundred thousand dollars life death benefits, one hundred thousand dollars health, and one hundred thousand dollars annuity, with a three hundred thousand dollar aggregate.

headings.title: Per-life and per-owner benefit limits for insurers placed on or after 2013
headings.reviewNote: Limits association liability, for insurers first placed under rehabilitation or liquidation on or after August 28, 2013, to contractual obligations or specified per-life caps (including five hundred thousand dollars for health benefit plans and two hundred fifty thousand dollars for annuities), with a five million dollar per-owner limit on nongroup life policies.

headings.title: Subrogation asset recovery and association expenses
headings.reviewNote: Provides that statutory coverage caps apply prior to subrogation recoveries or insolvent insurer asset distributions.

headings.title: Classification of long-term care policy riders
headings.reviewNote: Deems benefits provided under long-term care riders to be the same category as the underlying life or annuity contract.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Missouri Life and Health Insurance Guaranty Association, life/health/annuity accounts, and director supervision.

headings.title: Creation of guaranty association and separate accounts
headings.reviewNote: Creates nonprofit guaranty association with mandatory insurer membership and life, health, and annuity administrative accounts.

headings.title: Director supervision and open meeting authority
headings.reviewNote: Places guaranty association under director supervision and permits opening board meetings and records to the public.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs guaranty association board composition of seven to eleven insurers, director approvals, and expense reimbursements.

headings.title: Board of directors composition and member selection
headings.reviewNote: Provides for seven to eleven member insurers selected by members and approved by director to serve on board.

headings.title: Fair representation standard for board appointments
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to ensure fair representation of all classes of member insurers when approving board members.

headings.title: Reimbursement of director expenses without compensation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes reimbursing board members for necessary expenses incurred while barring additional board compensation.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes guaranty association powers to assume, reissue, or cover policies of impaired and insolvent member insurers.

headings.title: Association powers regarding impaired member insurers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes association to guarantee, assume, or reinsure policies of impaired insurers and provide financial loans.

headings.title: Association options and alternative policies for insolvent insurers
headings.reviewNote: Allows the association, in its discretion, either to guarantee, assume, reissue, or reinsure the policies or assure payment of obligations, or to provide benefits and coverage under specified terms, including thirty days' notice and substitute or alternative coverage without evidence of insurability.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates reissuance of terminated coverage, premium rate schedules, and premium tax obligations of insolvent insurers.

headings.title: Premium setting and reissuance of terminated coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires premiums for reissued terminated coverage at a different rate to be actuarially justified, set by the association by amount of coverage, age, and class of risk, subject to prior director approval.

headings.title: Association obligations cease on replacement of coverage
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the association's obligations under coverage of an impaired or insolvent insurer, or reissued or alternative coverage, cease on the date the coverage is replaced by another similar policy by the owner, insured, enrollee, or association.

headings.title: Guaranteed minimum interest rates under association coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires the association, when proceeding under subdivision (2) of subsection 2 of section 376.724 for policies with guaranteed minimum interest rates, to assure payment or crediting of a rate consistent with subdivision (3) of subsection 3 of section 376.717.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs nonpayment of premiums on association-continued policies and establishes association ownership of post-liquidation premiums.

headings.title: Effect of premium nonpayment on continued coverage
headings.reviewNote: Terminates association obligations to continue coverage if policyholders fail to make required premium payments.

headings.title: Association ownership of post-liquidation premiums
headings.reviewNote: Provides that premiums due after liquidation entry belong to the association and holds association liable for unearned premiums.

entries.reviewSummary: Empowers director to assume association duties upon inaction, provides advisory assistance, and grants broad court standing.

headings.title: Director assumption of association powers upon default
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to exercise association powers and duties if association fails to act within a reasonable time.

headings.title: Association advisory assistance to insurance director
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes association to render expert advice to director regarding rehabilitation, claims payment, and insurer obligations.

headings.title: Legal standing to appear and intervene in court
headings.reviewNote: Grants association statutory standing to intervene in Missouri and out-of-state judicial proceedings involving insolvent insurers.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes automatic statutory assignment of policyholder claims to association, asset priority, and equitable subrogation rights.

headings.title: Statutory assignment of rights by benefit recipients
headings.reviewNote: Deems benefit recipients to have assigned contractual and legal causes of action to association to the extent of benefits paid.

headings.title: Priority of association subrogation claims against assets
headings.reviewNote: Grants association subrogation claims equal statutory priority against insolvent insurer assets as original policyholders.

headings.title: Equitable and common law subrogation remedies preserved
headings.reviewNote: Preserves all common law subrogation and equitable remedies available to insurers and policyholders, including structured annuities.

entries.reviewSummary: Enumerates additional guaranty association powers including borrowing, reinsurance elections, business judgment, and multi-state groups.

headings.title: Contracting, borrowing, litigation, and reinsurance powers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes entering contracts, suing, borrowing funds, employing personnel, recovering improper claims, and electing reinsurance.

headings.title: Board exercise of reasonable business judgment
headings.reviewNote: Empowers board of directors to exercise reasonable business judgment in selecting economical means to provide benefits.

headings.title: Exclusivity of benefits provided under association plans
headings.reviewNote: Bars covered persons from claiming benefits beyond those provided under approved association plans and arrangements.

headings.title: Participation in multi-state guaranty associations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes guaranty association to join multi-state organizations to coordinate interstate insolvency administration.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes Class A administrative and Class B insolvency assessments against member insurers, allocation formulas, and interest.

headings.title: Assessment of member insurers by separate accounts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to levy assessments against member insurers separately for each account to fund association operations.

headings.title: Classification of Class A and B assessments
headings.reviewNote: Divides assessments into Class A for administrative costs and Class B to carry out obligations for impaired or insolvent insurers.

headings.title: Board determination of Class A assessment amounts
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the board determines Class A assessment amounts, which may be pro rata or nonpro rata, and if pro rata the board may credit them against future Class B assessments.

headings.title: Allocation of Class B assessments between accounts
headings.reviewNote: Allocates Class B assessments between accounts by a formula based on the impaired or insolvent insurer's premiums or reserves or another fair standard, with long-term care assessments allocated fifty percent to accident and health insurers and fifty percent to life and annuity insurers.

headings.title: Class B assessments proportional to in-state premiums
headings.reviewNote: Makes Class B assessments for each account proportional to each insurer's premiums received in this state for covered policies over the three most recent calendar years preceding the year the insurer became impaired or insolvent.

headings.title: Timing, accuracy, and licensure limits on assessments
headings.reviewNote: Provides that assessments are not made until necessary, that classification and computation need only be reasonably accurate, and that no insurer is assessed for accounts in which it is not licensed to transact business.

entries.reviewSummary: Allows abatement or deferral of assessments that endanger insurer obligations, caps annual assessments at two percent of average premiums, addresses allocation when the cap is insufficient, provides refunds of excess assets, and permits considering assessments in rates and dividends.

headings.title: Deferment of assessments endangering member solvency
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to defer member assessments if payment would hazard the company's financial capacity to meet obligations.

headings.title: Two percent annual maximum assessment cap per account
headings.reviewNote: Caps total annual assessments on any member insurer at two percent of average annual premiums across preceding three years.

headings.title: Plan of operation method for allocating funds when cap is insufficient
headings.reviewNote: Allows the board to provide in the plan of operation a method of allocating funds among claims, relating to one or more insurers, when the maximum assessment is insufficient to cover anticipated claims.

headings.title: Board refund of excess account assets to members
headings.reviewNote: Allows the board, by an equitable method in the plan of operation, to refund to member insurers in proportion to contributions the amount by which account assets exceed what is needed for the coming year, while retaining a reasonable amount for continuing expenses and future losses.

headings.title: Consideration of assessments in rates and dividends
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a member insurer may consider the amount reasonably necessary to meet its assessment obligations in determining premium rates and policy owner dividends for covered business.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires association plan of operation approved by director, administrative rules, and delegation to third-party organizations.

headings.title: Submission and director approval of plan of operation
headings.reviewNote: Requires association to submit a written plan of operation to the director to assure fair and equitable administration.

headings.title: Director promulgation of rules absent approved plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director, after notice and hearing, to adopt reasonable rules if the association fails to submit a suitable plan within one hundred twenty days after August 13, 1988 or suitable amendments later, continuing until modified or superseded by an approved plan.

headings.title: Mandatory member insurer compliance with plan of operation
headings.reviewNote: Directs all member insurers to comply with the approved plan of operation and related administrative regulations.

headings.title: Required contents and procedures in plan of operation
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates mandatory plan provisions including governance, asset handling, claims payment, records, and elections.

headings.title: Delegation of association powers to performing organizations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes plan of operation to delegate powers and duties to third-party corporations performing similar functions.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets director duties regarding premium statements, impairment demands, and liquidation, allows certificate suspension or forfeitures, provides a sixty-day appeal to the director, and sets interstate notices, board reports, and confidentiality of IRIS ratios.

headings.title: Director duties regarding premium data and liquidation
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to provide premium statements on board request, serve a demand on an impaired insurer to cure the impairment within a reasonable time, and be appointed liquidator or rehabilitator in proceedings involving a domestic insurer.

headings.title: Certificate suspension and monthly forfeitures for nonpayment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to suspend insurer licenses or levy monthly forfeitures up to five percent for delinquent assessments.

headings.title: Sixty-day appeal window to director and judicial review
headings.reviewNote: Gives member insurers sixty days to appeal association actions to director, with final decisions subject to court review.

headings.title: Liquidator notification to interested persons of insolvency
headings.reviewNote: Allows the liquidator, rehabilitator, or conservator of an impaired insurer to notify all interested persons of the effect of sections 376.715 to 376.758.

headings.title: Interstate regulatory notices and confidential IRIS ratios
headings.reviewNote: Directs insurance director to notify interstate commissioners of disciplinary actions and share confidential NAIC IRIS ratios.

headings.title: Director consultation with board on insurer solvency
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to seek board advice and recommendations regarding financial condition of companies seeking admission.

entries.reviewSummary: Empowers guaranty association board to make confidential recommendations regarding insurer solvency and report impaired companies.

headings.title: Confidential board recommendations on insurer solvency
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board upon majority vote to submit confidential reports and advice to director regarding company solvency and liquidation.

headings.title: Board duty to report impaired or insolvent insurers
headings.reviewNote: Requires board of directors to notify director promptly of any member insurer that may be impaired or insolvent.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes twenty percent annual premium and sales tax offsets over five years for paid guaranty assessments, requiring refund paybacks.

headings.title: Five-year premium tax offsets for paid assessments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes member insurers to offset twenty percent of paid guaranty assessments against annual premium tax over five years.

headings.title: Sales or use tax offset for exempt insurers
headings.reviewNote: Permits tax-exempt member insurers to offset twenty percent of assessments annually against Missouri sales or use tax liabilities.

headings.title: Repayment of tax offsets upon assessment refunds
headings.reviewNote: Requires member insurers to repay state tax authorities when previously offset guaranty assessments are refunded by association.

entries.reviewSummary: Preserves assessment liabilities, requires confidential meeting records until liquidation ends, and deems association a creditor.

headings.title: Preservation of policyholder assessment liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that guaranty association statutes do not reduce liability for unpaid assessments on policies with assessment liability.

headings.title: Confidentiality of association negotiation and meeting records
headings.reviewNote: Requires confidential recordkeeping of association meetings, opening records only upon proceeding termination or court order.

headings.title: Association deemed creditor of impaired or insolvent insurer
headings.reviewNote: Deems association a creditor to the extent of assets attributable to covered policies for funding continuing policy obligations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs court equitable distributions upon liquidation, policyholder welfare, and priority recovery of association funds before stockholders.

headings.title: Equitable court distribution considering policyholder welfare
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to distribute ownership rights in liquidation considering contributions of association and welfare of policyholders.

headings.title: Association claim recovery prior to stockholder distributions
headings.reviewNote: Bars distributions to stockholders of insolvent insurers until all association claims with interest have been fully repaid.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes receiver recovery of distributions paid to controlling affiliates within five years of liquidation, joint liability, and caps.

headings.title: Receiver right to recover five-year affiliate distributions
headings.reviewNote: Gives the receiver of a domestic insurer in liquidation or rehabilitation a right to recover, from controlling affiliates, distributions other than stock dividends made during the five years before the petition, subject to subsections 2 to 4 (source note: word 'through' appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Affirmative defense for lawful and reasonable distributions
headings.reviewNote: Bars recovery if insurer shows distribution was lawful, reasonable, and made without knowledge of impending default.

headings.title: Liability of controlling affiliates receiving distributions
headings.reviewNote: Holds controlling affiliates receiving or declaring distributions jointly and severally liable up to distribution amounts.

headings.title: Maximum recovery limited to insurer contractual deficiency
headings.reviewNote: Caps total recovery from controlling affiliates at amount needed beyond existing assets to pay insurer obligations.

headings.title: Joint liability of parent affiliates for insolvent entities
headings.reviewNote: Makes upper-tier controlling affiliates jointly liable for any deficiency resulting from an insolvent affiliate.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires annual association financial reports within 120 days, grants state tax exemption, and provides statutory immunity.

headings.title: Annual financial statement and activity report filing
headings.reviewNote: Subjects the association to director examination and regulation and requires an annual financial report and activities report not later than one hundred twenty days after the fiscal year (source note: word 'that' appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Exemption from state and local taxes and fees
headings.reviewNote: Exempts guaranty association from all state and local taxes and fees except for ad valorem real property taxes.

headings.title: Statutory immunity for association, directors, and regulators
headings.reviewNote: Confers immunity from civil liability upon association, member insurers, board directors, and insurance department personnel.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires delivery of approved summary documents and prominent disclaimers, and mandates non-coverage notices on uncovered policies.

headings.title: Mandatory delivery of approved guaranty summary document
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers to deliver approved guaranty association summary document to policyholders prior to or at delivery.

headings.title: Required contents of prominent summary document disclaimer
headings.reviewNote: Directs that summary document prominently warn of coverage limits and state that guaranty protection cannot be used in sales.

headings.title: Separate written notice for policies not covered by association
headings.reviewNote: Bars an insurer or agent from delivering an excluded policy or contract without a separate written notice, given before or at delivery, clearly and conspicuously disclosing it is not covered by the guaranty association, in a director-specified form.

entries.reviewSummary: Excludes insurers insolvent on August 13, 1988 from the guaranty act, requires liberal construction to effect its stated purpose, and limits application of the 2010 and 2018 amendments to insurers not already impaired or insolvent.

headings.title: Inapplicability to insurers insolvent prior to effective date
headings.reviewNote: Excludes from guaranty association coverage any insurer declared insolvent or impaired prior to statutory effective date.

headings.title: Liberal construction to effect the act's purpose
headings.reviewNote: Requires sections 376.715 to 376.758 to be liberally construed to effect the purpose stated in subsection 2 of section 376.715, which is an aid and guide to interpretation.

headings.title: 2010 amendments not applicable to previously impaired insurers
headings.reviewNote: Provides that amendments effective August 28, 2010 do not apply to a member insurer that was impaired or insolvent before August 28, 2010.

headings.title: 2018 amendments not applicable to previously impaired insurers
headings.reviewNote: Provides that amendments effective August 28, 2018 do not apply to a member insurer that was impaired or insolvent before August 28, 2018.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines insurer, policy of accident and sickness insurance, and director of insurance for individual health insurance statutory provisions.

headings.title: Definition of insurer for accident and sickness statutes
headings.reviewNote: Defines insurer as any insurance company writing accident and sickness insurance subject to sections 376.770 to 376.800.

headings.title: Definition of policy of accident and sickness insurance
headings.reviewNote: Defines accident and sickness policy to include contracts insuring against sickness or accidental bodily injury or death.

headings.title: Definition of director of insurance
headings.reviewNote: Defines director of insurance as the director of the department of commerce and insurance.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes style, arrangement, font size, exceptions, and family coverage requirements for individual accident and sickness policies.

headings.title: Mandatory requirements and formatting for individual policies
headings.reviewNote: Requires accident and sickness policies to state consideration and effective times, insure one person (or family members on an adult member's application), meet type size and form number requirements, set out exceptions and reductions, and limit incorporation of charter or bylaws (source note: word 'if' appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Standards for domestic policies delivered outside Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to require domestic insurers delivering policies out of state to meet Missouri statutory standards.

entries.reviewSummary: Extends health coverage for dependent children past limiting age if mentally or physically disabled and unmarried up to age twenty-five.

headings.title: Application to hospital and medical expense provisions
headings.reviewNote: Applies dependent disability continuation rules to hospital and medical expense coverages in accident and sickness policies.

headings.title: Continued coverage for disabled and dependent adult children
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits termination of coverage at limiting age for children incapable of employment due to mental or physical handicap.

headings.title: Continued coverage election for unmarried dependents age twenty-five or younger
headings.reviewNote: Keeps coverage in force at the policyholder's option, elected within thirty-one days after the limiting age, for resident unmarried dependent children no more than twenty-five without other coverage or Medicare entitlement.

headings.title: Effective date for handicapped child coverage extension
headings.reviewNote: Applies handicapped dependent child continuation protections to policies issued after statutory effective date.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates standard statutory provisions in accident and sickness policies: entire contract, grace period, reinstatement, and claims.

headings.title: Mandatory standard policy provisions and statutory wording
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates twelve required standard clauses: entire contract, time limits on defenses, grace period, reinstatement, and notice.

headings.title: Optional standard policy provisions authorized for insurers
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates optional clauses: change of occupation, misstatement of age, other insurance, illegal occupations, and intoxicants.

headings.title: Modification of inapplicable or inconsistent standard provisions
headings.reviewNote: Requires the insurer, with the director's approval, to omit inapplicable provisions and modify inconsistent provisions so the policy is consistent with its coverage.

headings.title: Order of appearance of standard provisions in policy
headings.reviewNote: Governs order of clauses in policies, permitting provisions to appear as separate items or grouped under captions.

headings.title: Third-party ownership of accident and sickness policies
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory references to insured do not prevent third persons with insurable interests from owning policies.

headings.title: Requirements for foreign insurers and foreign delivery
headings.reviewNote: Permits foreign insurers to include home jurisdiction provisions and domestic insurers to conform to foreign delivery laws.

headings.title: Director approval of policy forms, filing rules, and deemed approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires director approval of policies before delivery, directs filing rules with disapproval reasons within forty-five days or deemed approval, sets approval standards, allows exemptions by order or bulletin, and permits network-only managed care plans disclosed in the policy form.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires health insurers to pay public hospitals directly for services provided to insureds without requiring prior assignment of benefits.

headings.title: Definitions of assignment, claim, contract, and insured
headings.reviewNote: Defines assignment, claim, contract, and insured for purposes of direct payment to public hospitals or clinics.

headings.title: Mandatory direct benefit payments to public hospitals
headings.reviewNote: Requires health policies to pay covered benefits directly to public hospitals or clinics without requiring written assignments.

headings.title: Applicability to policies issued after September 1983
headings.reviewNote: Applies direct public hospital payment requirements to all health insurance contracts issued or renewed after September 28, 1983.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires covered individually underwritten health plans to provide alcoholism treatment coverage in certified facilities on the same basis as other illness (limitable to thirty days), with approval procedures, department rulemaking, certification, and exemptions.

headings.title: Mandatory coverage for alcoholism treatment in certified facilities
headings.reviewNote: Requires individually underwritten health plans providing hospital treatment to cover alcoholism treatment in hospitals or department-certified facilities on the same basis as other illness, with coverage permitted to be limited to thirty days per benefit period.

headings.title: Provider approval procedures and mental health certification
headings.reviewNote: Governs carrier approval of treatment programs, mandating reimbursement for any facility certified by mental health department.

headings.title: Department of mental health administrative rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department of mental health to promulgate rules necessary to administer certified alcoholism treatment coverage.

headings.title: Mandatory certification for state-funded substance programs
headings.reviewNote: Requires all substance abuse treatment programs receiving state funding to obtain certification from mental health department.

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental and limited benefit policies
headings.reviewNote: Excludes accident-only, specified disease, hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and short-term plans from alcoholism mandate.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits policy terms less favorable than statutory standards and directs that conflicting clauses be construed to conform to state law.

headings.title: Prohibited policy provisions less favorable than statute
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits any policy provision from making coverage less favorable to the insured or beneficiary than state statutory terms.

headings.title: Construction of conflicting policy clauses to conform
headings.reviewNote: Provides that nonconforming policies remain valid but conflicting provisions are construed to conform to governing state statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires health insurers to offer speech and hearing coverage, defining covered disorders and establishing written rejection options.

headings.title: Mandatory offer of speech and hearing coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires group and individual health policies to offer coverage for care of speech or hearing loss or impairment.

headings.title: Written offer of benefits and policyholder rejection
headings.reviewNote: Requires the offer of speech and hearing benefits to be in writing, permitting policyholders to reject coverage.

headings.title: Inclusion of speech benefits as standard coverage
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that insurers may include speech and hearing benefits as standard coverage without terms violating the statute.

headings.title: Scope of covered speech and hearing disorders
headings.reviewNote: Defines covered conditions to include disorders treated by licensed speech pathologists or audiologists within their licensure scope.

headings.title: Conflicting policy provisions voided to extent of conflict
headings.reviewNote: Declares any policy provision conflicting with speech and hearing statutory mandates void to the extent of the conflict.

headings.title: Department rulemaking authority for speech and hearing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department of commerce and insurance to promulgate rules necessary to implement speech and hearing mandates.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates coverage for low-dose mammography, digital tomosynthesis, cost-sharing prohibitions, and direct access without physician referral.

headings.title: Definition of low-dose screening mammography and tomosynthesis
headings.reviewNote: Defines low-dose mammography screening as X-ray examination with dedicated equipment, average radiation exposure of less than one rad mid-breast with two views per breast, and includes digital mammography and breast tomosynthesis.

headings.title: Required mammography screening schedules and supplemental imaging
headings.reviewNote: Requires coverage for a baseline mammogram at ages thirty-five to thirty-nine, annual mammograms at forty and over or for above-average risk, and medically necessary supplemental imaging such as magnetic resonance imaging or ultrasound.

headings.title: Parity with radiological examinations and reimbursement rates
headings.reviewNote: Requires coverage to be at least as favorable and subject to the same dollar limits, deductibles, and co-payments as other radiological examinations, with modality-based reimbursement from January 1, 2019 and no cost-sharing where section 376.1183 prohibits it.

headings.title: Direct patient access to mammography without referral
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits health carriers from requiring a physician referral or prescription prior to receiving screening mammography.

entries.reviewSummary: Conditions insured liability on attached applications, bars unauthorized alterations, and requires material falsity to void recovery.

headings.title: Application copy attached to policy required for defense
headings.reviewNote: Bars insurers from using applicant statements to void coverage unless a true copy of the application is attached to the policy.

headings.title: Alteration of written application requires applicant consent
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits altering written insurance applications without applicant consent, permitting only administrative insertions by insurers.

headings.title: Materiality requirement for false statements in applications
headings.reviewNote: Provides that false application statements do not bar recovery unless they materially affected acceptance of risk.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines actual charge and actual fee in specified disease policies as agreed network or government rate, barring excess claim payments.

headings.title: Definition of actual charge in disease policies
headings.reviewNote: Defines actual charge in specified disease policies as the negotiated network rate or government program reimbursement accepted.

headings.title: Prohibition on benefit payments exceeding actual charges
headings.reviewNote: Bars insurers from paying specified disease policy claims in amounts exceeding the defined actual charge or fee.

entries.reviewSummary: Exempts individual health insurance coverage from statutory other insurance provisions and authorizes administrative rulemaking.

headings.title: Inapplicability of other insurance clauses to individual plans
headings.reviewNote: Exempts individual health insurance coverage from statutory coordination of benefits and other insurance provisions of section 376.777.

headings.title: Director rulemaking authority and nonseverability clause
headings.reviewNote: Directs insurance director to promulgate implementation rules subject to chapter 536 and nonseverability conditions.

entries.reviewSummary: Cites the Child Health Insurance Reform Plan, defines terms, requires policies to offer child health supervision coverage from birth through age twelve at approximate intervals, and addresses written rejection and standard coverage.

headings.title: Title cited as Child Health Insurance Reform Plan
headings.reviewNote: Designates section as the Child Health Insurance Reform Plan.

headings.title: Definitions of child supervision and health insurer
headings.reviewNote: Defines child health supervision services, health care insurer, and health insurance policy excluding limited plans.

headings.title: Offer of child health supervision coverage through age twelve
headings.reviewNote: Requires family-covering policies to offer coverage for child health supervision services from birth through age twelve at approximate stated age intervals, subject to the same limits, deductibles, and coinsurance as other covered services.

headings.title: Written offer of benefits and policyholder rejection
headings.reviewNote: Requires child health supervision benefit offers to be in writing, permitting policyholder rejection.

headings.title: Standard coverage inclusion permitted
headings.reviewNote: Provides that nothing in the section prohibits the health care insurer from including any or all child health supervision coverage as standard coverage in its policies or contracts.

entries.reviewSummary: Restricts elective abortion coverage to optional riders with additional premium, applies to specified insurers, bars exchanges from offering such coverage, and limits application to contracts after September 28, 1983, with a source note recording a 1992 court annotation.

headings.title: Elective abortion coverage restricted to optional riders
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits health insurance coverage for elective abortions except through optional riders with additional separate premiums.

headings.title: Entities and plans subject to the rider requirement
headings.reviewNote: Provides that subsection 1 applies to contracts, plans, or policies of health insurers subject to the chapter, nonprofit corporations subject to chapter 354, and all health maintenance organizations.

headings.title: Health insurance exchanges barred from offering elective abortion coverage
headings.reviewNote: Bars state or federally administered health insurance exchanges within this state from offering plans that cover elective abortions, including through an optional rider.

headings.title: Applicability to policies delivered after statutory date
headings.reviewNote: Applies elective abortion rider requirements to all health insurance policies delivered or renewed in Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines health insurance contract and insurer, requires prompt refund of unearned premium upon notice of an insured's death, specifies who receives the refund, and excludes notice given more than one year after death.

headings.title: Definitions of health insurance contract and health insurer
headings.reviewNote: Defines health insurance contract (individual policies, health services corporation and health maintenance organization contracts, self-insured plans, and certain group coverage) and health insurer for purposes of the section.

headings.title: Prompt refund of unearned premium upon notice of death
headings.reviewNote: Requires a health insurer to promptly refund unearned premium upon notification of the death of a covered person, earning only the part of premium proportionate to the period the decedent was alive.

headings.title: Recipients of the unearned premium refund
headings.reviewNote: Requires the refund to be paid directly to the decedent's spouse, the primary insured if the decedent was an unmarried dependent, or otherwise the decedent's estate.

headings.title: Section inapplicable if notice given more than one year after death
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the section does not apply if notification of the insured's death is given to the health insurer more than one year after the death.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits reducing or denying health insurance benefits to individuals eligible for or receiving state Medicaid assistance.

headings.title: Denial or reduction of Medicaid benefits prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Bars health insurers from denying claims or reducing benefits because the insured is eligible for or receiving Medicaid.

headings.title: Contracts deemed primary coverage for medical assistance eligible
headings.reviewNote: Provides that all such contracts are deemed the primary coverage of an insured or dependent who is eligible for or receiving medical assistance under chapter 208.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates health insurance coverage offers for chemical dependency, outpatient/residential/inpatient care, and ninety-day hospital caps.

headings.title: Mandatory offer of chemical dependency treatment coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires health insurers to offer chemical dependency coverage for detox, outpatient, and residential care on parity with illness.

headings.title: Mandatory offer of recognized mental illness coverage
headings.reviewNote: Directs insurers to offer mental illness coverage including outpatient care, accredited residential treatment, and ninety-day hospital care.

headings.title: Acceptance or rejection of offered mental health benefits
headings.reviewNote: Permits policyholders to accept or reject mental health offers, with accepted coverage substituting for section 376.779.

headings.title: Offer of two annual diagnostic mental health sessions
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers to offer mental health benefits including at least two sessions per year with listed licensed professionals for diagnosis or assessment, not subject to preapproval and with the same cost-sharing as regular office visits.

headings.title: Mental health and chemical dependency act governs if offer rejected
headings.reviewNote: Provides that if the policyholder rejects the offer, coverage is governed by the mental health and chemical dependency insurance act in sections 376.825 to 376.836 (source note: those sections were repealed by H.B. 1298 Revision, 2014).

headings.title: Exemption for supplemental and limited benefit policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts accident-only, specified disease, hospital indemnity, Medicare supplement, and short-term policies from mental health mandate.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes mental health managed care regulations and grants civil immunity to members of medical quality assurance committees.

headings.title: Department rulemaking for mental health managed care standards
headings.reviewNote: Directs insurance department with mental health advice to promulgate managed care mental health guidelines and facility standards.

headings.title: Civil immunity for quality assessment committee members
headings.reviewNote: Confers immunity from civil liability upon members of federal quality assessment and assurance committees acting in good faith.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires health carriers to cover adopted children on same basis as other dependents from birth or placement, defining placement.

headings.title: Mandatory health coverage for adopted dependent children
headings.reviewNote: Requires health benefit plans to cover adopted children on the same basis as biological dependent children of enrollees.

headings.title: Coverage effective from birth or placement date
headings.reviewNote: Makes coverage effective from birth or physical placement if adoption petitions are filed within thirty days, including pre-existing conditions.

headings.title: Definitions of health plan, carrier, and placement
headings.reviewNote: Defines health benefit plan, health carrier, and physical placement of an adopted child in the adoptive parent custody.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits insurers from canceling health or dental policies solely due to incarceration and defines covered insurers broadly.

headings.title: Definition of insurer for incarceration protections
headings.reviewNote: Defines insurer broadly to include commercial insurers, HMOs, fraternals, dental plans, and third-party administrators.

headings.title: Cancel or deny coverage solely for incarceration prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Bars an insurer from cancelling or denying coverage on a health or dental insurance contract or policy solely on the grounds that the person is incarcerated under authority of law.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates health coverage for eating disorders, defines clinical terms, treatment plans, and medical necessity APA guidelines.

headings.title: Definitions for eating disorder diagnosis and therapy
headings.reviewNote: Defines eating disorders, medical care, psychiatric care, psychological care, therapy, and licensed treating professionals.

headings.title: Mandatory health benefit coverage for eating disorders
headings.reviewNote: Requires health benefit plans issued or renewed in Missouri to cover diagnosis and treatment of eating disorders under section 376.1550.

headings.title: Coverage limited to medically necessary treatment plans
headings.reviewNote: Limits coverage to medically necessary treatments delivered by licensed clinical professionals under written treatment plans.

headings.title: Treatment plan contents required for claim adjudication
headings.reviewNote: Requires treatment plans to include diagnosis, therapy type, frequency, duration, and clinical treatment goals upon carrier request.

headings.title: Medical necessity determinations under APA psychiatric guidelines
headings.reviewNote: Directs that medical necessity reviews consider overall mental health and follow American Psychiatric Association practice guidelines.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs application of Medicare supplement laws to individual and group policies, exempting employer-sponsored and non-supplement plans.

headings.title: Applicability of Medicare supplement laws to state policies
headings.reviewNote: Applies Medicare supplement statutes to individual and group supplement policies and certificates delivered in Missouri.

headings.title: Exemption for employer and labor organization plans
headings.reviewNote: Exempts employer-sponsored, union-sponsored, and trustee health plans for employees or retirees from Medicare supplement rules.

headings.title: Inapplicability to non-supplement health benefit plans
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that Medicare supplement statutes do not apply to general conversion plans not marketed as Medicare supplements.

entries.reviewSummary: Bars Medicare supplement benefit duplication, caps pre-existing exclusions at six months, and grants director regulatory standards.

headings.title: Duplication of Medicare benefits prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Bars Medicare supplement policies from duplicating benefits already provided by federal Medicare.

headings.title: Six-month limitation on pre-existing condition exclusions
headings.reviewNote: Caps pre-existing condition exclusions in Medicare supplement policies at six months from effective coverage date.

headings.title: Director regulations establishing supplement policy standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to adopt reasonable regulations setting specific standards for Medicare supplement policy provisions, which may cover renewability, eligibility, nonduplication, probationary periods, benefit limitations, elimination periods, replacement, recurrent conditions, and definitions.

headings.title: Conforming supplement regulations to federal standards
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to adopt regulations conforming state supplement rules to federal loss ratios and Medicare Select.

headings.title: Prohibition of unfair or discriminatory provisions
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to prohibit policy provisions that are unjust, unfair, or unfairly discriminatory to insured seniors.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires an outline of coverage to be delivered to Medicare supplement applicants, directs its format and content, and authorizes director rules on an informational brochure, notice captions for non-supplement policies, and replacement disclosure.

headings.title: Mandatory outline of coverage at application
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivering a standardized outline of coverage to applicants at the time of Medicare supplement application.

headings.title: Prescribed format and contents of coverage outline
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to prescribe the format and content of the outline, including a description of principal benefits, renewal provisions and age-based automatic premium increases, and a statement that the outline is a summary only.

headings.title: Director may prescribe informational brochure for Medicare-eligible persons
headings.reviewNote: Allows the director to prescribe by regulation a standard informational brochure for Medicare-eligible persons, to be provided with the outline of coverage or, for direct response policies, upon request and no later than policy delivery.

headings.title: Notice captions that coverage is not Medicare supplement
headings.reviewNote: Allows the director to adopt regulations for captions or notices informing prospective insureds that particular accident and sickness coverages sold to Medicare-eligible persons are not Medicare supplement coverage, excluding Medicare supplement and disability income policies.

headings.title: Director regulations on disclosure for replacement of coverage
headings.reviewNote: Allows the director to adopt reasonable regulations governing full and fair disclosure in connection with replacement of accident and sickness policies, subscriber contracts, or certificates by Medicare-eligible persons.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires refund of unearned Medicare supplement premiums within twenty days of cancellation notice, permitting electronic notice.

headings.title: Twenty-day refund of unearned supplement premiums
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers to refund unearned premiums beyond the cancellation month within twenty days of receiving notice.

headings.title: Written or electronic cancellation notice permitted
headings.reviewNote: Permits policyholders to notify insurers of Medicare supplement policy cancellations via written or electronic communication.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes administrative orders, civil injunctive actions, and level two penalties for Medicare supplement regulatory violations.

headings.title: Administrative orders and level two violation penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director administrative orders under section 374.046 and classifies violations as level two offenses.

headings.title: Civil court actions by director for injunctions
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to maintain civil court actions under section 374.048 to enjoin Medicare supplement statutory violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes continued health coverage for surviving, divorced, or separated spouses age fifty-five or older upon COBRA expiration.

headings.title: Post-COBRA continuation for spouses age fifty-five
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees continuation of hospital and medical coverage for surviving or divorced spouses age fifty-five following COBRA expiration.

headings.title: Continuation offer for dental, vision, and drug benefits
headings.reviewNote: Requires continued coverage offers for dental, vision, and prescription drug expenses if available to certificate holders.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes notice deadlines, fourteen-day administrator notifications, sixty-day election windows, and coverage continuation protections.

headings.title: Sixty-day notice of divorce or legal separation
headings.reviewNote: Requires separated or divorced spouses seeking continuation to notify plan administrators within sixty days of decree or COBRA end.

headings.title: Thirty-day employer notice upon certificate holder death
headings.reviewNote: Requires group policyholders to notify plan administrators of certificate holder deaths within thirty days.

headings.title: Fourteen-day administrator notice of continuation rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires plan administrators to mail continuation election forms and premium amounts within fourteen days of receiving notice.

headings.title: Termination of continuation rights upon election failure
headings.reviewNote: Provides that failure to return continuation election forms within sixty days terminates all continuation rights.

headings.title: Postponement of premiums upon administrator notice failure
headings.reviewNote: Postpones spouse premium obligations and maintains coverage if administrator fails to send timely election notice.

headings.title: Employer threshold of twenty or more employees
headings.reviewNote: Limits post-COBRA spousal continuation mandates to employers and plans with twenty or more certificate holders.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs life care certificate applications, annual statement renewal within ninety days with a late fee of fifty percent of the renewal fee, annual statement narrative, separate facility applications, oath by the chief executive officer, and recorded escrow agreements.

headings.title: Application for life care certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Requires a provider to file an application for a certificate of authority and, within ninety days of fiscal year end (unless extended with written consent), an annual statement and renewal application, with a late fee equal to fifty percent of the last renewal fee.

headings.title: Annual statement narrative on pro forma income differences
headings.reviewNote: Requires the annual statement to include a narrative describing material differences between prior pro forma income statements and actual results of operations, with revised pro forma income statements.

headings.title: Separate application for each facility
headings.reviewNote: Requires a separate certificate of authority application for each facility when an applicant has more than one facility offering continuing care.

headings.title: Application signed under oath by chief executive officer
headings.reviewNote: Requires the application for a certificate of authority to be signed under oath by the applicant's chief executive officer.

headings.title: Escrow agreement copies recorded as application exhibits
headings.reviewNote: Requires copies of escrow agreements executed under sections 376.940 and 376.945 to be recorded as exhibits to the application for a certificate of authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs the department to issue life care certificates of authority upon completed application, fee, and escrow compliance, sets a one-year term, requires a no-endorsement statement, and makes certificates nontransferable.

headings.title: Department issues certificate upon completed application and compliance
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to issue a certificate of authority, subject to escrow conditions, upon a completed application with exhibits, fee payment, and proof of compliance with sections 376.940 and 376.945.

headings.title: Certificate issued for one year unless sooner revoked
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a certificate of authority issued under the section, unless sooner revoked, is issued for a period of one year.

headings.title: Certificate must state it is not department endorsement
headings.reviewNote: Requires the certificate to state prominently that issuance is not approval, recommendation, or endorsement by the department and does not evidence the accuracy or completeness of the application or annual report.

headings.title: Certificates of authority nontransferable
headings.reviewNote: Provides that all certificates of authority are nontransferable.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires escrow accounts for life care entrance fees prior to construction, conditions for fund release, and thirty-six month refunds.

headings.title: Mandatory escrow of entrance fees during construction
headings.reviewNote: Requires providers to deposit entrance fees into escrow until construction is complete, loans secured, and occupancy met.

headings.title: Refund of escrowed fees after thirty-six months
headings.reviewNote: Directs escrow agents to refund entrance fees if release conditions are not satisfied within thirty-six months.

headings.title: Immediate refund upon provider notice of resident entitlement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes escrow agents to refund fees at any time upon notice from provider that resident is entitled to refund.

headings.title: Exemption for nonrefundable resident application fees
headings.reviewNote: Exempts reasonable nonrefundable application fees disclosed in annual statements from statutory escrow requirements.

headings.title: Applicability to life care contracts after September 1981
headings.reviewNote: Applies entrance fee escrow requirements only to life care contracts executed after September 28, 1981.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires fifty percent entrance fee reserves in escrow, debt service minimums, five percent move-out reserves, and liquid assets.

headings.title: Fifty percent entrance fee reserve in escrow
headings.reviewNote: Requires a provider to maintain in escrow a reserve of at least fifty percent of the first occupant's entrance fee, amortized and released at one percent per month, with a floor of one hundred percent of annual long-term debt payments on units occupied under life care contracts.

headings.title: Five percent reserve for contract move-out refunds
headings.reviewNote: Requires each provider to establish and maintain separately for each facility a reserve of not less than five percent of the facility's outstanding contractually obligated move-out refunds at fiscal year end.

headings.title: Liquid investment standards for required life care reserves
headings.reviewNote: Requires reserve funds under subsection 1 or 2 to be held in liquid assets such as federal government or other marketable securities or federally insured deposits or accounts (source note: word 'subsections' appears in original rolls of H.B. 1682, 2020).

headings.title: Applicability to living units constructed after September 1981
headings.reviewNote: Applies life care reserve requirements to contracts for living units constructed after September 28, 1981.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates Missouri Health Insurance Pool, mandatory insurer membership, board structure, and transition authority to federal programs.

headings.title: Creation of Missouri Health Insurance Pool entity
headings.reviewNote: Creates nonprofit Missouri Health Insurance Pool with mandatory membership for all health insurers in the state.

headings.title: Board of directors composition, terms, and appointments
headings.reviewNote: Establishes nine-member board including director and eight industry and public members appointed for three-year terms.

headings.title: Temporary legislative and hospital board appointments through 2009
headings.reviewNote: Provides for temporary expansion to fourteen members including legislative and hospital representatives through 2009.

headings.title: Reversion of board size to nine members
headings.reviewNote: Directs that board composition revert to nine members upon expiration of temporary legislative terms.

headings.title: Authority to transition pool enrollees to outside coverage
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to assist transitioning pool enrollees to external coverage while barring operation of state exchanges.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires the pool's board to submit a plan of operation for director approval, specifies plan content, requires 2013 transition amendments, and directs the director to promulgate transitional rules.

headings.title: Submission and director approval of plan of operation
headings.reviewNote: Requires board to submit a plan of operation to assure fair administration, effective upon director approval.

headings.title: Required contents of the pool's plan of operation
headings.reviewNote: Requires the plan to establish procedures for handling pool assets, select an administering insurer or third-party administrator, fill board vacancies, and collect assessments, due within thirty days of the assessment notice.

headings.title: 2013 plan amendments for transition and termination of policy issuance
headings.reviewNote: Requires the board, on or before September 1, 2013, to submit plan amendments necessary or suitable for a reasonable transition period allowing termination of issuance of policies by the pool.

headings.title: Required scope of transition amendments to the plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires the amendments to include subsection 2 requirements, address transition of covered individuals to alternative coverage after January 1, 2014, and address finalizing the pool's financial matters including assessments and claims expenses.

headings.title: Director review and transitional rules with nonseverability clause
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to review the transition plan and promulgate rules effective no later than October 1, 2013, effective only if compliant with chapter 536, with a nonseverability provision.

entries.reviewSummary: Protects employees from involuntarily losing group coverage because they may enroll in the pool, sets pre-2014 pool eligibility and ineligibility, allows termination when eligibility ceases, requires insurer notice of the pool, and provides pool coverage expires January 1, 2014.

headings.title: No involuntary loss of group coverage due to pool enrollment
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no employee shall involuntarily lose group coverage by employer decision on the grounds that the employee may subsequently enroll in the pool, and authorizes department rules to enforce it.

headings.title: Persons eligible for pool coverage before January 1, 2014
headings.reviewNote: Lists persons eligible for pool coverage before January 1, 2014 if they are and remain Missouri residents, including individuals rejected by insurers, federally defined and trade act eligible individuals, dependents, and certain involuntarily terminated persons.

headings.title: Persons not eligible for pool coverage
headings.reviewNote: Lists persons not eligible, including those with similar coverage (with exceptions), recipients of section 208.151 benefits, persons who left the pool within twelve months, persons for whom one million dollars was paid, inmates, certain substance-related conditions, and Medicare-eligible persons.

headings.title: Termination at end of policy period when eligibility ceases
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a person who ceases to meet eligibility requirements may be terminated at the end of the person's policy period.

headings.title: Insurer notice of the pool upon medically underwritten actions
headings.reviewNote: Requires an insurer taking actions based on medical underwriting that are likely to make a person pool-eligible (rejection, cancellation, or substantial reduction of coverage) to notify affected persons of the pool, eligibility requirements, and how to apply.

headings.title: Pool coverage expires January 1, 2014
headings.reviewNote: Provides that coverage under the pool shall expire on January 1, 2014.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs selection of administering insurer for three-year term, competitive bidding, operational duties, and wind-down administration.

headings.title: Competitive selection of administering insurer for three years
headings.reviewNote: Directs board to select an administering insurer through competitive bidding to serve a three-year administrative term.

headings.title: Duties of the administering insurer
headings.reviewNote: Requires the administering insurer to perform eligibility and claim-payment functions, establish premium billing, assure timely benefit payment, report to the board, determine annual premiums, expenses, and losses, and be paid as the plan provides.

headings.title: 2013 bid invitation for administering insurer or third-party administrator
headings.reviewNote: Requires the board, on or before September 1, 2013, to invite all insurers and third-party administrators to bid, with selection made prior to January 1, 2014.

headings.title: Administering insurer duties for winding down pool operations
headings.reviewNote: Requires administering insurer to submit detailed wind-down plans and perform remaining administrative claim functions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs annual pool accounting, assessment formulas on insurers and arrangements, future loss reserves, and general revenue deposit.

headings.title: Annual determination of total cost of pool operation
headings.reviewNote: Requires the pool administrator, after each fiscal year, to determine net premiums, expenses, and incurred losses, and defines total cost of pool operation as program expenses and losses exceeding program revenues.

headings.title: Assessment calculation formula for commercial health insurers
headings.reviewNote: Calculates insurer assessments proportionally based on Missouri premium writings and subscriber charges from preceding year.

headings.title: Assessment calculation formula for self-insured arrangements
headings.reviewNote: Calculates assessment for self-insured arrangements based on 110 percent of paid Missouri claims and benefits.

headings.title: Retention of excess assessments for future loss reserves
headings.reviewNote: Provides that assessments exceeding actual losses and expenses are held at interest and used by the board to offset future losses (including reserves for incurred but not paid claims) or to reduce pool premiums.

headings.title: Continuation of assessments until all pool claims paid
headings.reviewNote: Provides that assessments continue until the executive director gives notice to the board and director that all claims have been paid.

headings.title: Deposit of remaining assessment funds into general revenue
headings.reviewNote: Directs that any assessment moneys remaining after full payment of claims be deposited into state general revenue fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes high risk pool major medical coverage, standard risk rates, deductible tiers, preexisting condition exclusions, and benefit coordination.

headings.title: Major medical expense coverage and benefit schedules
headings.reviewNote: Directs high risk pool to offer major medical coverage, prescription drugs, and patient education services approved by director.

headings.title: Consideration of prevailing health insurance benefit levels
headings.reviewNote: Directs board to establish pool benefit levels, deductibles, and exclusions commensurate with representative health insurers.

headings.title: Premium rate schedules and demographic rating factors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes premium schedules based on age, sex, and location subject to prior approval by director.

headings.title: Standard risk rate determination and rate caps
headings.reviewNote: Establishes actuarial standard risk rate calculation, minimum initial rate percentage, and maximum premium rate caps.

headings.title: High and low deductible options and adjustments
headings.reviewNote: Requires pool coverage to provide an appropriate high and low deductible for the applicant to select, and allows deductibles and coinsurance factors to be adjusted annually under the medical component of the consumer price index.

headings.title: Preexisting condition exclusions and involuntary termination waiver
headings.reviewNote: Excludes preexisting conditions for twelve months and waives exclusion following involuntary coverage termination within sixty-three days.

headings.title: Exemption from preexisting condition exclusions for eligible individuals
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits preexisting condition exclusions for federally defined and trade act eligible individuals without significant coverage gaps.

headings.title: Coordination of benefits and recovery of overpayments
headings.reviewNote: Reduces pool benefits by other health insurance and workers compensation recoveries while authorizing setoff and recovery actions.

headings.title: Inclusion of prayer and spiritual healing expenses
headings.reviewNote: Includes expenses for comparable benefits for individuals relying solely on spiritual prayer healing as medical expenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires pool board to offer high-deductible health plans paired with health savings accounts, defines terms, and authorizes rules.

headings.title: Option for high deductible plan and health savings
headings.reviewNote: Requires board to offer high-deductible pool plans upon verification of compliance with federal health savings account law.

headings.title: Definitions of health savings account and high-deductible plan
headings.reviewNote: Incorporates federal statutory definitions for health savings accounts and qualifying high-deductible health plans.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and statutory nonseverability provisions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative rulemaking by pool board subject to standard nonseverability and legislative review provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts Limited Mandate Health Insurance Act, exempts qualifying small group policies from statutory benefit mandates, and specifies disclosures.

headings.title: Short title of Limited Mandate Health Insurance Act
headings.reviewNote: Establishes statutory citation as Limited Mandate Health Insurance Act.

headings.title: Scope and definition of limited mandate policies
headings.reviewNote: Defines limited mandate health insurance policies covering individuals, families, and employer groups of fifty or fewer employees.

headings.title: General mandate exemption and enumerated mandatory exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts limited mandate policies from state mandated benefits and practitioner inclusion requirements except for specified statutes.

headings.title: Eligibility conditions and required consumer disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Conditions sales eligibility on targeting uninsured or cost-burdened groups and providing prominent disclosures regarding reduced coverage mandates.

headings.title: Inapplicability of extension of benefits requirements
headings.reviewNote: Disapplies statutory benefit extension rules when a group replaces coverage with a limited mandate policy excluding such benefits.

headings.title: Application of dentist freedom of choice protections
headings.reviewNote: Preserves freedom of choice provisions for covered physician services that can be performed by licensed dentists.

entries.reviewSummary: Exempts excepted benefit plans from subsequent health insurance mandates, authorizes administrative disclosure waivers, and defines scope.

headings.title: Definitions for excepted benefit plan mandate exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Defines excepted benefit plan, health insurance mandate, and notice for statutory exemption purposes.

headings.title: Exemption from future health insurance mandates
headings.reviewNote: Exempts excepted benefit plans from health benefit mandates enacted on or after August 28, 2016 absent express statutory language.

headings.title: Director bulletin authority to exempt disclosure notices
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to issue bulletins exempting excepted benefit plans from statutory disclosure or notice rules.

headings.title: Limitations on exemption for altered benefit structures
headings.reviewNote: Limits mandate exemption to plans that do not materially expand coverage beyond customary excepted benefits or resemble comprehensive plans.
